Activatespawner.name: Activatespawner
Activatespawner.description: Activates a MythicMobs spawner, causing it to spawn mobs. Will not override any conditions or options set on the spawner.

attributes.name: spawners
attributes.description: The name of the spawner(s) to activate. This can accept groups and wildcards also using the appropriate syntax

Add Trade.name: Add Trade
Add Trade.description: Changes the trades of a villager. The villager will become a nitwit if it doesn't have any profession assigned when using this mechanic.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: The action to perform. Can be ADD, REMOVE,REPLACE

attributes.name: slot
attributes.description: The slot to be selected for the action. Slot starts at 0, so if a villager has 3 trades, the middle trade would be slot 1

attributes.name: ingredient
attributes.description: The first ingredient

attributes.name: ingredient2
attributes.description: The second ingredient

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: The result item of the trade

attributes.name: maxUses
attributes.description: The uses of the trade

attributes.name: experienceReward
attributes.description: If the trade should drop experience

attributes.name: villagerExp
attributes.description: The amount of experience to give to the villager upon successful trade

attributes.name: priceMultiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier for the price when the player has made the villager angry

attributes.name: demand
attributes.description: The demand of the trade

attributes.name: specialPrice
attributes.description: The special price for when the villager is friendly to the player (player reputation or hero of the village effect)

attributes.name: ignoreDiscounts
attributes.description: If the discounts should be ignored

examples:
TestVillager:
 Type: Villager
 Display: 'OwO'
 Skills:
 - addTrade{item=DIAMOND 1;item2=EMERALD 2;result=IRON_INGOT 3;expReward=True;villExp=999;multiplier=0} @self ~onDamaged
 - addTrade{action=REPLACE;slot=1;item=DIRT 1;item2=COAL 2;result=DIAMOND_BLOCK 3;expReward=True;villExp=999;multiplier=0} @self ~onSignal:rev

Addtag.name: Addtag
Addtag.description: Adds a scoreboard tag to the target.

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: The string-name of the tag

Animatearmorstand.name: Animatearmorstand
Animatearmorstand.description: Makes an armor stand assume a pose over a specified time

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the animation in ticks

attributes.name: smart
attributes.description: Whether to apply smart angle conversion

attributes.name: ignoreempty
attributes.description: Whether to ignore empty pose values

attributes.name: usedegrees
attributes.description: Interprets the input' values as degrees (0-360) if set to true and as radians (0-6.28) if set to false

attributes.name: head
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's head

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's body

attributes.name: leftarm
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's left arm

attributes.name: rightarm
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's right arm

attributes.name: leftleg
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's left leg

attributes.name: rightleg
attributes.description: The pose for the armorstand's right leg

Arm Animation.name: Arm Animation
Arm Animation.description: Makes the casting player swing their arm

Arrowvolley.name: Arrowvolley
Arrowvolley.description: Fires a volley of arrows towards the target with a number of configurable properties.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The number of arrows in the volley

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: How spread out the arrows are

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the arrows

attributes.name: fireTicks
attributes.description: The duration hit entities will burn for in ticks

attributes.name: removeDelay
attributes.description: The time the arrows will stay before disappearing in ticks

attributes.name: canPickup
attributes.description: Whether the arrows can be picked up by players

Atom.name: Atom
Atom.description: Creates an orbiting Atom effect at the location.

attributes.name: particleorbital
attributes.description: The particle that will be displayed at the orbitals

attributes.name: particlenucleus
attributes.description: The particle that will be displayed at the nucleus

attributes.name: amountnucleus
attributes.description: The amount of particles for the nucleus

attributes.name: orbitals
attributes.description: The amount of orbitals around the nucleus

attributes.name: amountorbital
attributes.description: The amount of particles for each orbital

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the orbitals

attributes.name: radiusnucleus
attributes.description: The radius of the nucleus

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.description: The rotation of the atom

attributes.name: ticks

attributes.name: interval

attributes.name: velocity

Attribute.name: Attribute
Attribute.description: Sets the base value of the targeted entity's attribute. Not supposed to be used on players.

attributes.name: attribute
attributes.description: The attribute to set

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the attribute

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the attribute

Attribute Modifier.name: Attribute Modifier
Attribute Modifier.description: Adds an attribute modifier to the attributable target. Not supposed to be used on players.

attributes.name: attribute
attributes.description: The attribute

attributes.name: operation
attributes.description: The operation to perform

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the modifier

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The modifier of the attribute

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the attribute

Aura.name: Aura
Aura.description: The Aura mechanic acts as a status effect on the target entity, and can trigger other skills over its duration. Auras allow you to create custom status effects (i.e. buffs and debuffs) that are tracked for their duration and can also be used in other mechanics and conditions.

attributes.name: auraName
attributes.description: Optional name, required to use associated mechanics & conditions that reference a specific aura. Given a random UUID if not defined.

attributes.name: components
attributes.description: The aura components to apply. Better explained later in the page

attributes.name: auratype
attributes.description: The type of the aura. It's similar to its name

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: A list of comma-separated tags that the aura will have. The tags do nothing on their own, but can be used to "mark" the aura and better check against it

attributes.name: attachmenttype
attributes.description: The Attachment to apply to the entity the aura is applied to

attributes.name: onStartSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the aura first starts

attributes.name: onTickSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed every [interval] ticks on the affected entity

attributes.name: onEndSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the aura ends

attributes.name: ShowBarTimer
attributes.description: If set, the aura will display a bar for caster during it

attributes.name: Charges
attributes.description: If set, the aura will fade when it hits zero charges. Modifiable by other mechanics.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The max duration (in ticks) the aura will persist.

attributes.name: Interval
attributes.description: How often (in ticks) the aura fires its onTick skill

attributes.name: maxStacks
attributes.description: How many times the aura stacks on the same targeted entity if applied multiple times

attributes.name: refreshDuration
attributes.description: Makes the aura's duration refresh to the amount defined in the mechanic should the entity have the same aura applied to it again

attributes.name: mergeSameCaster
attributes.description: Merges all auras of the same name applied by one entity to another into one aura (Prevents a mob from being able to stack an aura multiple times on the same entity)
attributes.default: false if any among mergeAll, overwriteAll or overwriteSameCaster is true

attributes.name: mergeAll
attributes.description: Merges all auras of the same name applied by any and all entities to another into one aura (Prevents multiple mobs from being able to stack an aura multiple times on the same entity)

attributes.name: overwriteSameCaster
attributes.description: When applied, stops all of the same auras applied on the target by the same caster and replaces them with the new aura (cannot be used with merge options)

attributes.name: overwriteAll
attributes.description: When applied, stops all of the same auras applied on the target and replaces them with the new aura (cannot be used with merge options)

attributes.name: CancelOnGiveDamage
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura deals any damage to another entity

attributes.name: CancelOnTakeDamage
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if entity with the aura takes any sort of damage

attributes.name: CancelOnDeath
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura dies

attributes.name: CancelOnCasterDeath
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the caster of the aura dies

attributes.name: CancelOnTeleport
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura teleports at all, whether by another mechanic or server command

attributes.name: CancelOnChangeWorld
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura changes worlds. (Most times applies to players)

attributes.name: CancelOnSkillUse
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura uses another skill while the aura is active

attributes.name: CancelOnQuit
attributes.description: Cancels the aura if the entity with the aura logs out. (Only really applies to players)

attributes.name: DoEndSkillOnTerminate
attributes.description: Whether or not the aura will run onEndSkill when it's removed by auraremove mechanic

attributes.name: attachmentmodel
attributes.description: The model of the attachment

attributes.name: attachmentstate
attributes.description: The state the model will be playing

attributes.name: attachmentcolor
attributes.description: The color applied to the model

attributes.name: attachmentscale
attributes.description: The scale of the model

attributes.name: attachmentViewRadius
attributes.description: The view radius of the model. Leave as -1 to use ModelEngine's default settings

attributes.name: attachmentEnchanted
attributes.description: Whether the model should have an enchantment glint applied to it

attributes.name: attachmentGlowing
attributes.description: Whether the model should be glowing

attributes.name: attachmentglowcolor
attributes.description: The glow color of the model, if attachmentGlowing is set to true

attributes.name: attachmentCulling
attributes.description: Whether the model should be able to be culled by ModelEngine

attributes.name: attachmentoffset
attributes.description: The model's offset from the attached entity, in a x,y,z,yaw,pitch format.Can also be written as x,y,z or x,y,z,yaw

attributes.name: bartimerdisplay
attributes.description: The text in the bossbar

attributes.name: bartimercolor
attributes.description: The Color of the bossbar

attributes.name: bartimerstyle
attributes.description: The Style of the bossbar

Auraremove.name: Auraremove
Auraremove.description: Removes an aura from the target.

attributes.name: auraName
attributes.description: The name of the aura

attributes.name: stacks
attributes.description: The amount of stacks

Barcreate.name: Barcreate
Barcreate.description: Creates a custom boss bar on the casting mob (cannot be player).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the bossbar.

attributes.name: display
attributes.description: The text displayed on the bar

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: How filled the bossbar is. Must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The Color of the bossbar

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: The Style of the bossbar

Barremove.name: Barremove
Barremove.description: Removes a custom boss bar on the casting mob (cannot be player).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the bossbar to remove

Barset.name: Barset
Barset.description: Modifies a custom boss bar on the casting mob (cannot be player).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the bossbar to modify/set

attributes.name: display
attributes.description: The text displayed on the bar

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: How filled the bossbar is. Must be between 0.0 and 1.0.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The Color of the bossbar

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: The Style of the bossbar

Basedamage.name: Basedamage
Basedamage.description: Damages the target entity for a percentage of the mob's damage. Inherits every attribute of the Damage mechanic.

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: The percentage of damage to deal

attributes.name: useAttribute
attributes.description: Whether the damage should use the real entity's attack attribute, instead of its raw base damage

examples:
AMob:
 Type: HUSK
 Damage: 10
 Skills:
 - basedamage{m=1.5} @target ~onDamaged

Beam.name: Beam
Beam.description: Creates a beam of a material between the caster and the target

attributes.name: onhitskill
attributes.description: The skill to execute when the beam hits an entity. Currently not supported

attributes.name: ontickskill
attributes.description: The skill to execute each tick. The origin will be the starting location

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Duration of the beam in ticks

attributes.name: tickinterval
attributes.description: Tick interval of the beam

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: Material of the beam

attributes.name: rotationspeed
attributes.description: Rotation speed of the beam in degrees per tick

attributes.name: hitradius
attributes.description: Hit Radius of the beam

attributes.name: startyoffset
attributes.description: The starting y offset of the beam from the caster's location

attributes.name: endyoffset
attributes.description: The end y offset of the beam from the target's location

Blackscreen.name: Blackscreen
Blackscreen.description: Causes the player's screen to black out.

Block Mask.name: Block Mask
Block Mask.description: Creates a mask of blocks around the specified target. The blocks created or changed by this effect will disappear or rather reset to their former state after the specified duration expired. Resetting the blocks at an earlier point in time can be achieved by using the blockunmask-effect (see example below).

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The type of block used for the blockmask

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the blockmask effect

attributes.name: radiusy
attributes.description: The y component of the radius

attributes.name: noise
attributes.description: Defines the randomness of the effect

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Duration of the effect in ticks

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the effect. Sphere/Cube

attributes.name: noair
attributes.description: Mask no air blocks only

attributes.name: onlyair
attributes.description: Mask air blocks only

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the effect

attributes.name: occ
attributes.description: If onlyair is used, target transparent blocks as well

Block Unmask.name: Block Unmask
Block Unmask.description: The blockunmask effect is used to revert blockchanges made by the blockmask effect. For instance, this effect can be used in a high radius after a mob has died in order to “clean up” the fake block updates sent. However this is not necessary, because the fake block changes created by the blockmask effect will be reverted if a chunk is reloaded for a player (but will only revert for that player).

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the blockunmask effect

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the effect. Sphere/Cube

Block Wave.name: Block Wave
Block Wave.description: Creates a wave of the specified blocks, with varying shapes, speeds and blocks.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The material used for the blockwave

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the blockwave effect

attributes.name: radiusy
attributes.description: The y radius of the blockwave effect

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Duration of the effect in ticks

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: The shape of the effect (Sphere/Cube)

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The speed of the effect

attributes.name: horizontalvelocity
attributes.description: The speed of the effect in the horizontal direction

attributes.name: specificvelocities
attributes.description: Whether to make use of the vx, vy and vz attributes

attributes.name: velocityx
attributes.description: The speed of the effect on the x axis

attributes.name: velocityy
attributes.description: The speed of the effect on the y axis

attributes.name: velocityz
attributes.description: The speed of the effect on the z axis

attributes.name: noise
attributes.description: The noise of the effect

attributes.name: hidesourceblock
attributes.description: Whether to hide the source block

attributes.name: ignoreair
attributes.description: Whether air blocks should be ignored

Blockdestabilize.name: Blockdestabilize
Blockdestabilize.description: Turns the blocks at the target location(s) into falling blocks, making them start to fall as if affected by gravity

Blockphysics.name: Blockphysics
Blockphysics.description: Force a block physics update at the target location

Bloody Screen.name: Bloody Screen
Bloody Screen.description: Shows the near world border effect. Players must enable Fancy Graphics to see the effect.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The time (in ticks) that the effect is active

attributes.name: cancel
attributes.description: If true, it stops any existing redscreen

Bonemeal.name: Bonemeal
Bonemeal.description: Applies a bone meal effect to the target blocks.

attributes.name: blockFace
attributes.description: The block face to apply bonemeal to

Bossborder.name: Bossborder
Bossborder.description: Traps the the target player within a vanilla world border around the caster.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the border

Bouncy.name: Bouncy
Bouncy.description: Applies an aura to the target that makes it bouncy

attributes.name: onBounceSkill
attributes.description: The metaskill to execute on bounce

attributes.name: cancelevent
attributes.description: Whether to cancel fall damage for the duration of the aura

Break Block And Give Item.name: Break Block And Give Item
Break Block And Give Item.description: Breaks the block at a target location and gives item(s). This mechanic will also drop the block (with exception of Bedrock). REQUIRES forcesync=true.

attributes.name: dodrops
attributes.description: Whether or not to drop the block/s

attributes.name: doeffect
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the break block particles (?)

attributes.name: usetool
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the tool in the players hands (?)

attributes.name: doFakeLooting
attributes.description: Plays the pickup-item animation from the origin

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: An array of item materials, or droptables.

examples:
#Items Document
CustomItem:
 Id: GOLDEN_SHOVEL
 Display: 'Lucky Shovel'
 Skills:
 - skill{s=dirtToDiamonds;sync=true} @origin ~onBreakBlock

#Skills Document
dirtToDiamonds:
 TargetConditions:
 - blocktype{t=DIRT,GRASS_BLOCK} true
 Skills:
 - breakBlockAndGiveItem{dodrops=false;items=diamond}

Breakblock.name: Breakblock
Breakblock.description: Will break a block at the target location. This mechanic will also drop the block (with exception of Bedrock). REQUIRES forcesync=true.

attributes.name: doDrops
attributes.description: Whether or not to drop the block/s

attributes.name: doEffect
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the break block particles

attributes.name: useTool
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the tool in the players hands

fields.name: Tests
fields.description: These tests were run using /mm test cast TestingBreakBlock When a player calls this without a tool in there hand it does not drop a block or create the particle effects. When a player calls this without a tool in there hand it does drop the block, but does not create the particle effects. The same is true if setting doEffect to false. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it drops the block and does not play the particle effects. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it does not drop a block, nor does it create the particle effects. When a player calls this with a tool in their hand it does drop a block, and does create the particle effects.

Cancel Skill.name: Cancel Skill
Cancel Skill.description: Cancels the execution of the Metaskill when triggered
examples:
SomeSkill:
 Skills:
 - message{m="Hello"} @server
 - cancelSkill ?isMonster #cancels the rest of the skill from executing if the condition is met
 - message{m="It appears i am not a monster! Yay!"} @server

Cancelevent.name: Cancelevent
Cancelevent.description: Cancel the Event that triggered the skill. This mechanic has several important requirements in order to execute properly:
examples:
CancelDamageEvent:
 Skills:
 - CancelEvent
 - message{m="&cYou cannot hurt this mob!"} @trigger

Cast.name: Cast
Cast.description: Cast is an Aura mechanic similar to Skill in that it executes a skill, however Cast instead "casts" the skill similar to how you'd expect an RPG hero or monster to do so. Cast will execute the given skill if the cast completes successfully (e.g. if the aura finishes normally), but can be interrupted.

attributes.name: onCastSkill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if the cast finishes successfully

attributes.name: onInterruptedSkill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if the cast is interrupted

attributes.name: onnotargetsskill
attributes.description: Skill to execute if no target is found

attributes.name: skillname
attributes.description: Display name of the spell in the cast bar

attributes.name: showCastBar
attributes.description: Whether to show the cast bar

attributes.name: cancelOnMove
attributes.description: Whether to cancel the aura if the caster moves

examples:
# This will be cast once the duration has elapsed
FrostBlast-Cast:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=20}
 - message{m="MUHAHA, TAKE THAT!"}

# This will be cast while the main casting is still in progress
FrostBlast-Tick:
 Skills:
 - particle{p=end_rod;a=4;hs=1;vs=1} @selflocation{y=1}

# This will be cast if the aura is somehow removed
FrostBlast-Interrupted:
 Skills:
 - message{m="Tsk, you got me!"}

# This will be cast if the original target for the aura no longer exist
FrostBlast-NoTargets:
 Skills:
 - message{m="...Where has everyone gone to?"} @World

Chain.name: Chain
Chain.description: Chain allows you to make skills that bounce between targets, like a "chain lightning" type skill.

attributes.name: onBounce
attributes.description: The skill that bounces between targets

attributes.name: bounces
attributes.description: How many times the chain should bounce

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: The delay between bounces

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: How far the skill will bounce to a new target

attributes.name: hitSelf
attributes.description: Whether the chain should affect the caster

attributes.name: hitTarget
attributes.description: Whether the chain should do the initial from the caster to the first target

attributes.name: hitPlayers
attributes.description: Whether the chain should bounce to players

attributes.name: hitNonPlayers
attributes.description: Whether the chain should bounce to non-players

attributes.name: bounceConditions
attributes.description: Conditions applied to the bounce target

Chainmissile.name: Chainmissile
Chainmissile.description: Shoots a chaining homing missile at the target

attributes.name: bounces
attributes.description: How many times the chain should bounce

attributes.name: bounceradius
attributes.description: How far the skill will bounce to a new target

attributes.name: returnToCaster
attributes.description: If the missile should return to the caster

attributes.name: bounceConditions
attributes.description: The conditions for the skill to bounce, similar to the chain mechanic

examples:
## Skills.yml ##
ChainMissile:
 Skills:
 - ChainMissile{bounces=10;r=10;in=1.25;oT=CM_oT;oH=CM_oH;i=1;md=200;mr=30;v=5;hnp=true;hp=true;hR=1;vR=1;sB=False;sE=false;tyo=1;hs=true;hfs=1}
CM_oT:
 Skills:
 - effect:particles{particle=flame;a=1;hs=0;vs=0;s=0;y=0} @origin
CM_oH:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=1;pkb=true}

Cinematic Camera.name: Cinematic Camera
Cinematic Camera.description: Plays a smooth cinematic camera path for the target player, moving their view along a series of keyframes. Useful for cutscenes, boss intros, and scripted reveals. The mechanic must target a player.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Name of a camera path defined under cutscenes/. Required if points is not set.

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: Inline keyframes, separated by ;. Wrap the value in double quotes when it has more than one keyframe, or every keyframe after the first is ignored. Alternative to path.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Total duration in ticks, split across the legs that have no hold. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: easing
attributes.description: Default easing curve for legs that do not override it. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: loop
attributes.description: Whether the path repeats until cancelled. Only used with points; a path file sets its own.

attributes.name: maxDuration
attributes.description: Safety cap in ticks for looping paths, so a loop can never run forever.

attributes.name: freezePlayer
attributes.description: Makes the player invulnerable and locks their movement (walk/fly speed 0) for the duration.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: DISPLAY (smooth) or TELEPORT (per-tick teleport, no interpolation).

attributes.name: onStart
attributes.description: Skill executed when the cinematic begins. It runs with this mechanic's caster and targets, not with the player as caster.

attributes.name: onEnd
attributes.description: Skill executed when the cinematic ends. It runs with this mechanic's caster and targets, not with the player as caster.

Cinematic Cancel.name: Cinematic Cancel
Cinematic Cancel.description: Interrupts an active cinematicCamera for the target player, immediately returning their camera and control. The mechanic must target a player.

Clear Experience.name: Clear Experience
Clear Experience.description: Clears experience for the target player

Clear Experience Levels.name: Clear Experience Levels
Clear Experience Levels.description: Clears the experience levels for the targeted players

Clear Target.name: Clear Target
Clear Target.description: Forces the target of the mechanic to reset its current target

Clearthreat.name: Clearthreat
Clearthreat.description: Makes a mob clear its threat table. Removes all entities from the threat table completely.

Close Dialog.name: Close Dialog
Close Dialog.description: Closes the target player's open dialog, if any, even from another plugin.

Closeinventory.name: Closeinventory
Closeinventory.description: Will close the inventory of the target (must be a player to function).

Command.name: Command
Command.description: Executes a command for each target supplied.

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: The command to execute

attributes.name: asCaster
attributes.description: If true the command will execute from the caster instead of the console.

attributes.name: asOp
attributes.description: Whether to execute the command with all permissions

attributes.name: asTarget
attributes.description: Will execute the command as the targeted entity

attributes.name: requireTarget
attributes.description: Only executes if the skill has a target

examples:
Skills:
 - command{c="give <target.name> gold_ingot 20"} @trigger ~onInteract
 - command{c="minecraft:tp <target.name> <mob.uuid>"} @self ~onDamaged
 - command{c="say HELLO <target.name>";asTarget=true;asOp=true} @NearestPlayer{r=10}

Consume.name: Consume
Consume.description: Damages each entity targeted for the given amount, and heals the casting mob for each entity that takes damage this way.

attributes.name: damage
attributes.description: The amount of damage to deal

attributes.name: heal
attributes.description: The amount of healing per mob damaged

Consumeslot.name: Consumeslot
Consumeslot.description: Removes an item from a specific slot of the player's inventory.

attributes.name: slot
attributes.description: The inventory slot to remove the item from. Accepts Slots 0 to 35, or equipment slots.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of items to remove

Currencygive.name: Currencygive
Currencygive.description: Gives money to players. This mechanic needs the Vault plugin and an economy plugin installed to work and Vault must be enabled in the MythicMobs config-general.yml file

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of money.

Currencytake.name: Currencytake
Currencytake.description: Takes money from players. This mechanic needs the Vault plugin and an economy plugin installed to work. It also requires Vault being enabled in the config.yml

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of money taken from player.

Damage.name: Damage

attributes.description: The amount of damage to deal

attributes.name: ignoreArmor
attributes.description: Whether or not to ignore armor, but will still use enchantment modifiers when calculating total damage

attributes.name: preventknockback
attributes.description: Whether or not to prevent knockback

attributes.name: preventimmunity
attributes.description: Whether or not to prevent the damage immunity ticks on the target by setting them to 0 after the damage is inflicted

attributes.name: damagecause
attributes.description: Sets the damage cause for this damage mechanic. (This option is only available for 1.17+)

attributes.name: ignoreenchantments
attributes.description: Whether or not to ignore enchantments when calculating total damage.(This option is only available for 1.19+)

attributes.name: noanger
attributes.description: Whether or not to generate anger when damaging the entity

attributes.name: ignoreinvulnerability

attributes.name: damageshelmet

attributes.name: ignoreeffects

Decapitate.name: Decapitate
Decapitate.description: Drops a copy of the target players' head. Does nothing when used against a non-player entity.

Delay.name: Delay
Delay.description: Causes the current skilltree to be delayed by X ticks. The number of ticks can be given positionally as delay 60, or through the ticks attribute as delay{ticks=60}. Both forms accept placeholders, so the duration can be resolved at runtime, for example delay{ticks=<caster.var.x>}. Delay can also be used as an attribute directly inside of mechanics by adding the delay=TICKS universal attribute. This way, the delay is not applied to the entire skilltree but only to the single mechanic.

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: The number of ticks to delay the execution. Accepts placeholders.

Determine Condition.name: Determine Condition
Determine Condition.description: Determines the outcome of a Metaskill that is used as a Condition via the MetaskillCondition condition

attributes.name: determination
attributes.description: Modifies whether the associated condition should return or not. Can be true or false

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How the determination value is modified. Can be SET, OR, AND, NOT. Works like you would expect a boolean operation to, apart from SET that simply overrides any already defined determination value

Directional Velocity.name: Directional Velocity
Directional Velocity.description: Changes the velocity on the target entity on a specific vector

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw of the vector for the velocity change

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch of the vector for the velocity change

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The magnitude of the velocity change

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode to use

Disengage.name: Disengage
Disengage.description: Causes the caster to leap backwards away from the target entity

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the leap

attributes.name: velocityy
attributes.description: The y component of the velocity of the leap

Disguise.name: Disguise
Disguise.description: Runs a disguise string on the casting mob. This skill requires Libs' Disguises to be installed to enable Disguise functionality.

attributes.name: disguise
attributes.description: The disguise to apply to the mob.

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the disguise

examples:
TestingDisguiseMechanic:
 Skills:
 - disguise{d="Zombie setYModifier -1.5 setPitchLocked setInvisible setHelmet PLAYER_HEAD"} @self

Disguise Modify.name: Disguise Modify
Disguise Modify.description: Modifies an already applied disguise on the target entity. Like the Disguise mechanic, LibsDisguises must be installed. Here you can find our documentation on the matter. The syntax for the disguise in this mechanic is completely equivalent to the one used in the /modifydisguise command.

attributes.name: disguise
attributes.description: The options to modify in the disguise

Disguisetarget.name: Disguisetarget
Disguisetarget.description: Runs a disguise string on the target mob. This skill requires Libs' Disguises be installed to enable Disguise functionality.

attributes.name: disguise
attributes.description: The disguise to apply to the target.

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the disguise

examples:
Skills:
 - disguisetarget{d="player libraryaddict setCustomName '&7Jeb' setSkin Notch.png"} @target

Dismount.name: Dismount
Dismount.description: Causes the mob to jump off of its mount, if it is mounted on anything. Otherwise, does nothing.

Display Transformation.name: Display Transformation
Display Transformation.description: Sets the targeted display entity's transformations

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: The action to use. Can be SET, ADD, MULTIPLY, DIVIDE

attributes.name: transformationtype
attributes.description: The type of the transformation. Can be TRANSLATION, SCALE, RIGHT_ROTATION, LEFT_ROTATION

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the transformation

examples:
ExampleDisplayEntity:
 Type: block_display
 Skills:
 # sets the translation transform to `0,0,1` after 10 seconds the entity spawns
 - displaytransformation{action=set;transformation=translation;value=0,0,1;delay=200} @self ~onSpawn

 # rotates the item display along the y-axis (similar to a dropped item)
 - displaytransformation{action=MULTIPLY;transformation=LEFT_ROTATION;val=0,0.707,0,0.707} @self ~onTimer:10

Doppleganger.name: Doppleganger
Doppleganger.description: Copies the appearance of the target player. Does nothing if the target is not a player. This skill requires Libs' Disguises to be installed to enable disguise-functionality.

attributes.name: hasnameplate
attributes.description: Whether the disguise should have a nameplate

attributes.name: usePlayerName
attributes.description: Uses the player name as the nameplate

Dropitem.name: Dropitem
Dropitem.description: Drops a set of items or optionally a DropTable.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Items to drop. Can be a comma-separated list of items, or a DropTable. You can specify an amount by putting a space and a number after the item name.

attributes.name: naturally
attributes.description: Whether the items should be dropped naturally

attributes.name: onDropSkill
attributes.description: Metaskill to be execute when the item drops. Inherits the dropped item entity as the target(s)

attributes.name: dynamic
attributes.description: Forces the drop to be parsed as a dynamic item each time

Ejectpassenger.name: Ejectpassenger
Ejectpassenger.description: Ejects any passengers that are currently riding the mob.

Ender.name: Ender
Ender.description: Plays the effect of an eye of ender breaking at the location of the targeter.

Ender Beam.name: Ender Beam
Ender Beam.description: Summons an Ender Crystal which shoots a beam towards the target.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The time (in ticks) that the effect is active

attributes.name: yoffset
attributes.description: The default vertical offset from the casting mob

Ender Dragon Reset Crystals.name: Ender Dragon Reset Crystals
Ender Dragon Reset Crystals.description: Generates the EnderDragon crystals if an enderdragon battle is going on in the target location's dimension

Ender Dragon Set Phase.name: Ender Dragon Set Phase
Ender Dragon Set Phase.description: Sets the EnderDragon phase on the target EnderDragon entity

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The phase to set

Ender Dragon Set Respawn Phase.name: Ender Dragon Set Respawn Phase
Ender Dragon Set Respawn Phase.description: Sets the EnderDragon respawn phase if an EnderDragon battle is going on in the target location's dimension

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The phase to set

Ender Dragon Spawn Portal.name: Ender Dragon Spawn Portal
Ender Dragon Spawn Portal.description: Generates the portal of the EnderDragon battle

attributes.name: withPortals
attributes.description: Whether to generate the portal of the EnderDragon battle

Endprojectile.name: Endprojectile
Endprojectile.description: Terminates the projectile this mechanic has been called from, activating its onEnd skill in the process.

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: The conditions to check before terminating the projectile

examples:
Mob:
 Type: HUSK
 Skills:
 - skill{s=ExplodingProjectile} @target ~onTimer:20
 - aura{auraName=explode;d=2} @self ~onTimer:200

Equip.name: Equip
Equip.description: Equips the mob with an item. Uses the exact same syntax as the Equipment configuration.

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The item config string to run on the mob.

Equipcopy.name: Equipcopy
Equipcopy.description: Causes the caster to equip a copy of the target's equipment

attributes.name: slots
attributes.description: The slots to copy

Explosion.name: Explosion
Explosion.description: Creates an explosion at the target entity or location.

attributes.name: yield
attributes.description: The yield (power) of the explosion

attributes.name: blockdamage
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the explosion will damage blocks

attributes.name: fire
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the explosion leaves fire behind

Extinguish.name: Extinguish
Extinguish.description: Removes any fire ticks from the target entity

Fake Explosion.name: Fake Explosion
Fake Explosion.description: Creates an explosion effect at the specified target. Will play the sound and the particle effects, but won't cause any damage.

Fake Lightning.name: Fake Lightning
Fake Lightning.description: Will strike a “fake” lightning bolt at the specified target.

attributes.name: localized
attributes.description: Whether the lightning should only be seen/heard by players in radius

attributes.name: localizedradius
attributes.description: The radius of the localized effectOnly works if localized is set to true!

Fawepaste.name: Fawepaste
Fawepaste.description: Pastes a Schematic using the FAWE Plugin found here: FAWE

attributes.name: schematic
attributes.description: Which schematic to load

attributes.name: pasteID
attributes.description: The paste's id. Can be used to undo the paste via the undoPaste mechanic

attributes.name: pasteAir
attributes.description: Should air be pasted?

attributes.name: xOffset
attributes.description: The X offset of pasting the Schematic from the target

attributes.name: yOffset
attributes.description: The Y offset of pasting the Schematic from the target

attributes.name: zOffset
attributes.description: The Z offset of pasting the Schematic from the target

attributes.name: rotation

attributes.name: center

attributes.name: chestDropTable

attributes.name: trapchestDropTable
attributes.description: Which MythicMob Drop Tables to supply the Trapped Chests within the Schematic with

attributes.name: blocksPerTick
attributes.description: The number of blocks that are placed every tick. If 0, all of the blocks will be pasted in a single tick

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: If greater than 0, will undo the paste operation after that amount of ticks has elapsed

Feed.name: Feed
Feed.description: Feeds the targeted player. Doesn't work for other mobs.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of hunger to restore

attributes.name: saturation
attributes.description: The amount of saturation to restore

attributes.name: overfeed
attributes.description: Whether or not to overfeed

Fill Chest.name: Fill Chest
Fill Chest.description: Fills a chest with a list of items, or a droptable

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: Items to fill a chest with. Can be a comma-separated list of items, or a DropTable

attributes.name: shouldStack
attributes.description: Should the given items stack if possible. true/false

attributes.name: shouldempty
attributes.description: Should the container be emptied before the items are added. true/false

Firework.name: Firework
Firework.description: Creates a firework effect at the target.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The Type of firework. See below for a list.

attributes.name: power
attributes.description: The flight duration of the firework.

attributes.name: flicker
attributes.description: Whether to add the flicker effect to the explosion.

attributes.name: trail
attributes.description: Whether to add the trail effect to the firework rocket.

attributes.name: colors
attributes.description: The color of the firework explosion, in RGB or hex

attributes.name: fadecolors
attributes.description: The fade colors of the firework explosion, in RBG or hex

Flames.name: Flames
Flames.description: Creates the flames effect at the location of the targeter. Imitates the appearance of Minecraft's mob spawner block flames and thus has a randomness-factor to it.

Follow Path.name: Follow Path
Follow Path.description: Crates an aura that causes the holding mob to follow a path. This mechanic is also an aura.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: A list of either coordinates in the format (x,y,z) or targeters

attributes.name: onGoalSkill
attributes.description: The metaskill to execute when the last point is reached

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The minimum distance the mob must be from each point in order to having "reached" it

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: The speed multiplier of the movement

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The maximum duration of the mechanic. Unless set, it's the maximum possible value for an integer

attributes.name: timeoutdistance
attributes.description: If set, if the distance between the mob and the next point is greater than this value, it will be immediately teleported to the next point

attributes.name: timeouttime
attributes.description: If set, if the mob has not reached the next point in less than this allotted time, it will be teleported to the next point

For Each.name: For Each
For Each.description: Executes the specified metaskill once and separately for each target of the mechanic. Each metaskill that will be called will have a single entity/location (from among the original targets) as its inherited target.

attributes.name: targettype
attributes.description: Which type of targets this mechanic should iterate on. Can be ALL, ENTITY or LOCATION

examples:
# Skills file
IndexForEach:
 Skills:
 - foreach{skill=IndexSkill} @PIR{r=10;sort=NEAREST}

IndexSkill:
 Skills:
 - message{m="Target number <skill.var.index>"} @self

For Each Pin.name: For Each Pin
For Each Pin.description: Runs a given metaskill for each pin in a multi-pin

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the pin

For Each Value.name: For Each Value
For Each Value.description: Executes the specified metaskill once and separately for each value of the specified list/map formatted value. Each metaskill that will be called will have special skill parameters set depending on the iterated value:

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: The list or map formatted string to iterate on

examples:
# Skills file
ExampleForEachValue:
 Skills:
 - setvariable{var=skill.listnames;type=LIST;val="Steve,Alex"} @self
 - foreachvalue{skill=ExampleSkill;values=<skill.var.listnames>} @self # Can also directly use the entry1,entry2,entry3... syntax

ExampleSkill:
 Skills:
 - message{m="Found you :D"} @PlayerByName{name=<skill.value>}

# Skills file
ExampleForEachValueForMap:
 Skills:
 - setvariable{var=skill.mapnames;type=MAP;val="Steve=hello;Alex=1,2,3"} @self
 - foreachvalue{skill=ExampleSkill;values=<skill.var.mapnames>} @self # Can also directly use the key=value;key2=value2... syntax

ExampleSkill:
 Skills:
 - message{m="You have a value of <skill.value>"} @PlayerByName{name=<skill.key>}

Forcepull.name: Forcepull
Forcepull.description: Teleports all targeted entities to a location within <spread> blocks of the casting mob.

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: How spread out players will be from the casting mob

attributes.name: vspread
attributes.description: Lets you override the vertical spread value

Form Line.name: Form Line
Form Line.description: Makes the casting mob follow a linear path to a location

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: A list of either coordinates in the format (x,y,z) or [targeters]

attributes.name: onGoalSkill
attributes.description: The [metaskill] to execute when the last point is reached

attributes.name: tolerance
attributes.description: The minimum distance the mob must be from each point in order to have "reached" it

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: The speed multiplier of the movement

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The maximum duration of the mechanic. Unless set, it's the maximum possible value for an integer

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.description: Sets the ticks frozen in powdered snow. Freeze ticks are capped at 140 ticks for players. (requires 1.17)

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: Ticks frozen in powdered snow

examples:
#Inline version for premium users
Freeze_CauseFreezeEffect_Inline:

 - aura{d=100;i=1;onTick=[ - freeze{ticks=280} - damage{a=1;cd=2;damagecause=FREEZE} ]} @self

#Normal version
Freeze_CauseFreezeEffect_Normal:
 Skills:
 - aura{d=100;i=1;onTick=Freeze_CauseFreezeEffect_Normal_onTick} @self
Freeze_CauseFreezeEffect_Normal_onTick:
 Skills:
 - freeze{ticks=280}
 - damage{a=1;cd=2;damagecause=FREEZE}

Geyser.name: Geyser

Give Experience Levels.name: Give Experience Levels

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of levels to give

Giveitem.name: Giveitem
Giveitem.description: Gives an item to the target. Supports Droptables.

attributes.name: fakeLooting

Globalcooldown.name: Globalcooldown

Goat Ram.name: Goat Ram
Goat Ram.description: Causes the casting goat mob to ram the targeted entity

Goto.name: Goto

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: The movement speed modifier

attributes.name: spreadH

attributes.name: spreadV

Guardianbeam.name: Guardianbeam

attributes.description: The time (in ticks) for which the effect will be active

attributes.name: ontickskill

attributes.name: onendskill

Heal.name: Heal

Hide.name: Hide

Hologram.name: Hologram

Ignite.name: Ignite

Itemspray.name: Itemspray

Leap.name: Leap

Match Rotation.name: Match Rotation

attributes.description: In seconds. Allows for decimal values.

attributes.name: delay
attributes.description: Delays the execution of the mechanic by a set number of ticks.

attributes.name: repeat
attributes.description: How many times the mechanic should be repeated. If repeatInterval is set to 0, this becomes the number of executions rather than repetitions

attributes.name: repeatInterval
attributes.description: How many ticks must elapse between repetitions

attributes.name: targetInterval
attributes.description: How many ticks must elapse between target selection

attributes.name: origin
attributes.description: [PREMIUM]* Change the origin to whatever targeter is supplied. Does not work if more than one target is parsed. origin=@Forward{f=10}The targeter of the origin attribute will be parsed separately from the mechanic's targeter, so if you use something like origin=@targetedlocation it will not return the mechanic's explicit target, but the metaskill's inherited one

attributes.name: power
attributes.description: Power multiplier

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether to cast the mechanic from origin. This only works with a select few mechanics, and is usually listed as one of their attributes, too

attributes.name: targetisorigin
attributes.description: Whether to set the target of the mechanic to be the origin

attributes.name: targetcreative
attributes.description: Whether to target creative players

attributes.name: splitPower
attributes.description: Whether to split the power between targets

attributes.name: faulty
attributes.description: Whether the mechanic should use the old vector formula

attributes.name: chance
attributes.description: The chance of the mechanic executing. For instance, 0.1 is a 10% chance

attributes.name: forcesync
attributes.description: Whether to force the mechanic to be run synchroniously with the main Minecraft thread. This generally worsens performances (albeit usually in a non-perceptible fashion), but some mechanics needs this to be set to true (for instance, the cancelevent mechanic, since an event cannot be cancelled if the mechanics comes in "late" and the event has already happened)

Missile.name: Missile
Missile.description: The missile mechanic is similar to the projectile mechanic and can use any of the Projectile's Inheritable Attributes. Missiles however are homing and will track down their targets. Missiles can target both a location and an entity.

attributes.name: Inertia
attributes.description: Sets the "turning-rate" of the missile. Lower values make the missile turn around faster. Use big numbers (10-100) when trying to make your missiles turn slowly.

attributes.name: Bounces
attributes.description: Should the projectile bounce. Bounce radius depends on the projectile's hitbox. Premium Only.

attributes.name: BounceVelocity
attributes.description: Every time the projectile bounces, its velocity will be multiplied by this value. Premium Only .

attributes.name: startWithParentVelocity
attributes.description: Whether the missile, if called from another projectile, should start with the same velocity as the parent projectile

attributes.name: HugSurface
attributes.description: Whether or not the projectile should move along the ground.

attributes.name: HugLiquid
attributes.description: when using hugSurface will also move on top of liquids

attributes.name: HeightFromSurface
attributes.description: For NORMAL projectiles, how high above the surface the projectile should glide if HugSurface is set to TRUE. For METEOR projectiles, how high above the surface the projectile starts above the target.

attributes.name: MaxClimbHeight

attributes.name: MaxDropHeight
attributes.description: The number of attempts the projectile will make to decrease its y-location before terminating itself, when the projectiles is "hugging" either a block or a liquid

attributes.name: highAccuracyMode
attributes.description: Whether to use high-accuracy mode, which raytraces every tick to ensure the projectile cannot ever go through anything. Values can be true, false, PLAYERS_ONLY

attributes.name: hitnonplayers
attributes.description: Whether the missile should hit non player entities

Orbital.name: Orbital
Orbital.description: The Orbital skill fires a special type of projectile that will orbit around the target and can also act as an Aura, inheriting all of its attributes. Like the projectile, it will trigger other skills on anyone that is hit by it during its orbit. Much like projectile, it's great for creating complex skills, such as a fire shield, and is a very complex skill to master.

attributes.name: onHit
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile hits something. Targets hit are inherited by the meta-skill

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the orbit around the target

attributes.name: hitRadius
attributes.description: The radius around the orbital in which targets can be hit

attributes.name: verticalHitRadius
attributes.description: The y component of the hitradius

attributes.name: points
attributes.description: How many "points" that comprise the circle that makes up the orbit. More points will make the circle more defined, but will also increase the time it takes to complete an orbit

attributes.name: startingpoint

attributes.name: tickinterpolation
attributes.description: Interpolates additional points between each tick of the projectile, running onTick multiple times

attributes.name: rotationx
attributes.description: Rotates the orbital along the X axis. Rotation is done in radians, i.e. 3.14 is half a rotation, 6.28 is a full rotation

attributes.name: rotationy
attributes.description: Rotates the orbital along the Y axis. Rotation is done in radians, i.e. 3.14 is half a rotation, 6.28 is a full rotation

attributes.name: rotationz
attributes.description: Rotates the orbital along the Z axis. Rotation is done in radians, i.e. 3.14 is half a rotation, 6.28 is a full rotation

attributes.name: offsetx
attributes.description: Offsets the orbital along the X axis of the target

attributes.name: offsety
attributes.description: Offsets the orbital along the Y axis of the target

attributes.name: offsetz
attributes.description: Offsets the orbital along the Z axis of the target

attributes.name: angularVelocityX

attributes.name: angularVelocityY

attributes.name: angularVelocityZ

attributes.name: rotate

attributes.name: reversed
attributes.description: Whether the orbital should rotate in the opposite direction

attributes.name: hitPlayers
attributes.description: Whether can hit players

attributes.name: hitNonPlayers
attributes.description: Whether can hit non players

attributes.name: hitSelf
attributes.description: Whether can hit caster

attributes.name: hugsurface
attributes.description: Whether or not the orbital should move along the ground

attributes.name: hugliquid
attributes.description: Whether using hugSurface will also make the orbital move on top of liquids

attributes.name: heightfromsurface
attributes.description: How high above the surface the orbital should glide if HugSurface is set to true

attributes.name: maxclimbheight
attributes.description: The number of attempts the projectile will make to increase its y-location by 1 before terminating itself, when the projectiles is "hugging" either a block or a liquid

attributes.name: maxdropheight
attributes.description: The number of attempts the projectile will make to decrease its y-location by 1 before terminating itself, when the projectiles is "hugging" either a block or a liquid

attributes.name: bullettype
attributes.description: The Projectile Bullet Type. Also makes the orbital inherits every related attribute

attributes.name: castAsOrbital

attributes.name: immunedelay

attributes.name: drawhitbox

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of potion effect to apply.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the effect in ticks [1].

attributes.name: level

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Whether not to override the current potion effect or not.

attributes.name: hasParticles

attributes.name: hasIcon

attributes.name: ambientparticles
attributes.description: Whether to show ambient particles.

Potionclear.name: Potionclear
Potionclear.description: Clears all potion effects from the target entity

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: The type or list of types of potion effects to clear. Not providing a type will clear all effects.

Print Parent Tree.name: Print Parent Tree
Print Parent Tree.description: Prints debug information regarding the Metaskill executing the mechanic and its SkillTree

Prison.name: Prison
Prison.description: Encases the target entity inside a temporary prison of blocks. The created blocks will disappear automatically after the specified duration.

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The Material (block type) the prison is made out of.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) the prison will last

attributes.name: breakable
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether or not the prison blocks can be broken.

attributes.name: materialdata
attributes.description: Deprecated. The data of the material, which existed in older versions of the game. If present, the plugin will try to convert the material to its new equivalent

Projectile.name: Projectile
Projectile.description: The Projectile skill fires a meta-"projectile" that can be decorated using particle and sound effects. It's great for creating complex, aesthetically pleasing skills, such as shadow bolts, balls of ice, or even meteors. It has a lot of options (more than any other mechanic) and can be a bit of a nightmare to jump into without knowing what you're doing. It will disappear after hitting an entity or location that is able to stop the projectile. This behavior can be configured via attributes like stopatblock, stopatentity and stopconditions

attributes.name: onStartSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile starts at the projectile's origin location.

attributes.name: onTickSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed every [interval] ticks at the projectile's origin location

attributes.name: onHitSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile hits entities that are allowed be hit. Targets hit are inherited by the meta-skill.

attributes.name: onEndSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile ends.

attributes.name: onBounceSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile bounces. Premium Only.

attributes.name: onHitBlockSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile hits a block.

attributes.name: onInteractSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when the projectile is interacted with.

attributes.name: BulletType
attributes.description: The type of the bullet. If set, additional attributes becomes available depending on the specified bullet type. A list of bullet types and associated attributes is available below

attributes.name: Interval
attributes.description: How often (in ticks) the projectile updates its position

attributes.name: HorizontalRadius
attributes.description: The horizontal radius entities will be hit in around the projectile.

attributes.name: VerticalRadius
attributes.description: The vertical radius entities will be hit in around the projectile.

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The max duration (in ticks) the projectile will persist.

attributes.name: MaxRange
attributes.description: The maximum range (in blocks) the projectile will travel.

attributes.name: Velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the projectile, expressed in blocks traveled per second

attributes.name: DeathDelay
attributes.description: Delays the removal of project bullets when the projectile is terminated

attributes.name: StartYOffset
attributes.description: Lets you offset where on the casting mob the projectile shoots from.

attributes.name: StartFOffset
attributes.description: How far in front of the mob the projectile starts

attributes.name: TargetYOffset
attributes.description: Lets you offset where on the target the projectile shoots at.

attributes.name: SideOffset
attributes.description: The value of this attribute gets inherited by StartSideOffset and EndSideOffset if no value is specified for them

attributes.name: StartSideOffset
attributes.description: How far to the side of the mob the projectile starts

attributes.name: EndSideOffset
attributes.description: How far to the side of the target location the projectile will end up

attributes.name: startingdirection
attributes.description: Start direction of the projectile. For now, it only works if inherited by a missile mechanic

attributes.name: HorizontalOffset
attributes.description: Horizontal Offset will rotate the projectile's horizontal starting velocity around a 360-degree axis

attributes.name: VerticalOffset
attributes.description: Vertical Offset will add a slope to the projectile's starting direction. To give it a specific angle, you can use this image as reference: the value you need will be the number shown in red divided by 100 (so if you want 40°, you will need to input 83.9/100 = 0.839)

attributes.name: Accuracy
attributes.description: Determines the accuracy of the projectile

attributes.name: HorizontalNoise
attributes.description: The randomness of the projectile in horizontal direction

attributes.name: VerticalNoise
attributes.description: The randomness of the projectile in the vertical direction

attributes.name: StopAtEntity
attributes.description: Whether the projectile will stop upon hitting a targetable entity

attributes.name: StopAtBlock
attributes.description: Whether the projectile will stop upon hitting an opaque block

attributes.name: PowerAffectsRange
attributes.description: Whether a mob's power level affects the projectile's range

attributes.name: PowerAffectsVelocity
attributes.description: Whether a mob's power level affects the projectile's velocity.

attributes.name: Interactable
attributes.description: Whether the projectile is interactable

attributes.name: HitSelf
attributes.description: Whether the projectile can hit the caster

attributes.name: HitPlayers
attributes.description: Whether the projectile can hit players

attributes.name: HitNonPlayers
attributes.description: Whether the projectile can hit non player entities

attributes.name: HitTarget
attributes.description: Whether the projectile can hit the mechanic's target

attributes.name: HitTargetOnly
attributes.description: Whether the projectile can only hit the mechanic's target

attributes.name: ImmuneDelay
attributes.description: Sets the immunity delay (when the target can be hit by the projectile again)

attributes.name: hitConditions
attributes.description: A list of conditions that a target must meet in order for the projectile to be able to hit it. Premium Only Mechanic

attributes.name: stopconditions
attributes.description: A list of conditions that a target must meet in order for the projectile to end when hitting them

attributes.name: hitBlockConditions
attributes.description: A list of conditions evaluated against the block location the projectile would stop at. Only applies when the projectile stops on blocks (stopAtBlock); if any condition fails, the projectile passes through instead of stopping there. Premium Only

attributes.name: doEndSkillOnHit
attributes.description: Whether the onEnd metaskill should be run when the projectile ends by hitting an entity

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether the projectile should start from the origin of the mechanic

attributes.name: requireLineOfSight
attributes.description: Whether the starting point must have line-of-sight to the origin. Values can be true, false, PLAYERS_ONLY

attributes.name: drawHitbox
attributes.description: Draw the hitbox of the projectile, useful for debugging

attributes.name: tickinterpolation
attributes.description: Interpolates the specified amount of additional points between each tick of the projectile. The onTick and onHit skills will be applied there as well. Useful to fill in the gaps with super-fast projectiles and also prevent entities from being "skipped over"

attributes.name: shareSubHitboxCooldown
attributes.description: Whether all meg sub hitboxes should share the same immune delay with its base entity

attributes.name: hitTargeter
attributes.description: An entity targeter. Once the projectile hits, targeted entities will be targeted by the onHit Metaskill and given immune delay just like the projectile's main target

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The "type" of projectile. Default projectiles are launched from the mob's location towards the target. METEOR type projectiles fall from the sky above the target.

attributes.name: gravity
attributes.description: Determines the gravity of the projectile; use fractions (0.1-0.2) for low gravity

attributes.name: Bounces
attributes.description: Should the projectile bounce. Bounce radius depends on the projectile's hitbox. Premium Only.

attributes.name: BounceVelocity
attributes.description: Every time the projectile bounces, its velocity will be multiplied by this value. Premium Only .

attributes.name: HugSurface
attributes.description: Whether or not the projectile should move along the ground.

attributes.name: HugLiquid
attributes.description: when using hugSurface will also move on top of liquids

attributes.name: HeightFromSurface
attributes.description: For NORMAL projectiles, how high above the surface the projectile should glide if HugSurface is set to TRUE. For METEOR projectiles, how high above the surface the projectile starts above the target.

attributes.name: MaxClimbHeight
attributes.description: The number of attempts the projectile will make to increase its y-location before terminating itself, when the projectiles is "hugging" either a block or a liquid

attributes.name: MaxDropHeight
attributes.description: The number of attempts the projectile will make to decrease its y-location before terminating itself, when the projectiles is "hugging" either a block or a liquid

attributes.name: highAccuracyMode
attributes.description: Whether to use high-accuracy mode, which raytraces every tick to ensure the projectile cannot ever go through anything. Values can be true, false, PLAYERS_ONLY

attributes.name: bulletforwardoffset
attributes.description: The offset of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletYOffset
attributes.description: The Y offset of the bullet

attributes.name: arrowtype
attributes.description: The type of the projectile to use. Can be NORMAL,SPECTRAL,TRIDENT

attributes.name: bulletmaterial
attributes.description: The material of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletspin
attributes.description: The spin of the bullet

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The Audience of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletModel
attributes.description: The CustomModelData integer for the material (define model strings on a MythicItem instead)

attributes.name: bulletColor
attributes.description: The color of the material, if applicable

attributes.name: bulletmatchdirection
attributes.description: Should the bullet face where the projectile is facing

attributes.name: bulletEnchanted
attributes.description: Should the material be enchanted

attributes.name: mob
attributes.description: The mob of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletKillable
attributes.description: Allow other entities to damage the projectile bullet

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch rotation, in radians

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw rotation, in radians

attributes.name: roll
attributes.description: The roll rotation, in radians

attributes.name: rotation
attributes.description: The rotation of the bullet in radians, in the x,y,z format

attributes.name: pitchspeed
attributes.description: The pitch rotation speed

attributes.name: yawspeed
attributes.description: The yaw rotation speed

attributes.name: rollspeed
attributes.description: The roll rotation speed

attributes.name: rotationspeed
attributes.description: The rotation speed of the bullet, in the x,y,z format

attributes.name: bulletcustommodeldata
attributes.description: The CustomModelData integer for the material

attributes.name: bulletscale
attributes.description: The scale of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletBillboarding
attributes.description: The billboard type of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletbrightness
attributes.description: The bullet's brightness

attributes.name: bulletbrightnesssky
attributes.description: The bullet's sky light brightness

attributes.name: bulletCullingDistance
attributes.description: The range in which the bullet will be visible

attributes.name: tx
attributes.description: The translation on the x axis

attributes.name: ty
attributes.description: The translation on the y axis

attributes.name: tz
attributes.description: The translation on the z axis

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: The translations on the axes, in the x,y,z format

attributes.name: hideFirstTick
attributes.description: Hides the item for the first tick

attributes.name: bulletCullingHeight
attributes.description: The bullet's display culling height

attributes.name: bulletCullingWidth
attributes.description: The bullet's display culling width

attributes.name: bulletgen
attributes.description: If MythicCrucible is installed, the generation option for the bullet item

attributes.name: bulletstate
attributes.description: The state to play for the MEG model

attributes.name: bulletGlowing
attributes.description: Whether the bullet's model should be glowing

attributes.name: bulletglowcolor
attributes.description: The glow color of the bullet, if bulletGlowing is set to true

attributes.name: bulletCulling
attributes.description: Whether to apply culling for the bullet model

attributes.name: bulletViewRadius
attributes.description: From how far the bullet can be seen, if greater than 0.

attributes.name: bulletalod
attributes.description: Whether to use LOD culling on the bullet

attributes.name: bulletText
attributes.description: The text of the bullet

attributes.name: bulletBillboard
attributes.description: The billboard type of the bullet

attributes.name: forcedBulletRotation
attributes.description: Forces the rotation of the bullet with the specified pitch, yaw and roll, in the x,y,z format. Leave empty to allow the bullet to dynamically rotate based on the travel direction

attributes.name: bulletRotatesBasedOnDirection
attributes.description: Whether the text bullet should rotate based on the direction of movement. Might not be what you expect

attributes.name: backgroundcolor
attributes.description: The Background color, in the ARGB format

Projectilevelocity.name: Projectilevelocity
Projectilevelocity.description: Modifies the velocity of the calling Projectile or Missile. In this context, it works the same as the Velocity mechanic.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The operation to perform. Can be SET, ADD, REMOVE, DIVIDE, or MULTIPLY.

attributes.name: velocityx
attributes.description: Velocity on the x-axis. Can be negative.

attributes.name: velocityy
attributes.description: Velocity on the y-axis. Can be negative.

attributes.name: velocityz

attributes.description: If the change in velocity should be relative to the projectile's facing direction. In this instance, the z axis becomes forward/backward, y becomes up/down and x becomes left/right

Push Block.description: Pushes the block at the target location in the given direction using piston logic. Direction can be either cardinal direction or a location targeter. If given a targeter, the block will be pushed once towards that location. Mechanic follows piston rules and will push other connected slime blocks as well, but only if they're adjacent or in front of the block - it cannot push connected blocks behind the pushed block.

Runaigoalselector.name: Runaigoalselector
Runaigoalselector.description: Change pathfindergoals. It is not possible to use every goal on every entity. To change the ai of an entity, you need to use clear first. After that you can use the runaigoalselector and add the goals you need. Unlike the mob configuration, if you use the runaigoalselector skill, you can only use one pathfindergoal in the mechanic. But aslong as you dont use clear, the pathfindergoal is added to the end of the already existing goals of the entity.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: The ai goal selector you want to append

examples:
ChangePathfinderGoalExample:
 Skills:
 - runaigoalselector{goal=clear} # wipes previous pathfinding objectives
 - runaigoalselector{goal=fleesun} # prioritizes avoiding sunlight exposure
 - runaigoalselector{goal=randomstroll} # randomly wanders
 - runaigoalselector{goal="patrol 1494,38,10;1494,38,-10;1514,38,-10;1514,38,10"} # passively wanders between various coordinates
