attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: The amount of ticks the cooldown will last

Set Parent.name: Set Parent
Set Parent.description: Sets the "Parent" of the casting MythicMob as the targeted entity. The Parent can be either a Player or another MythicMob. Works with the @Parent Targeter, and the IsParent Condition.

Set Pathfinding Malus.name: Set Pathfinding Malus
Set Pathfinding Malus.description: Sets the pathfinding malus of a mob, influencing how a particular entity evaluates different types of blocks when calculating its path

attributes.name: malus
attributes.description: The type of block or terrain the entity can encounter

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: A weight that represents how "undesirable" the associated block or terrain is for pathfinding. Can be negative

Set Pitch.name: Set Pitch
Set Pitch.description: Sets the head pitch of the target entity

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The value the pitch will be set to

attributes.name: pose
attributes.description: The pose to assign

Set Projectile Direction.name: Set Projectile Direction
Set Projectile Direction.description: Sets the calling projectile's movement direction to the given target

attributes.name: magnitude
attributes.description: The magnitude of the change. A value of 1 will make the projectile change direction perfectly. Lower values will interpolate the changed direction position between 0 and 100%

Set Raider Can Join Raid.name: Set Raider Can Join Raid
Set Raider Can Join Raid.description: Sets if the target raider entity can join a raid or not

attributes.name: bool
attributes.description: Whether the entity can join the raid

Set Text Display.name: Set Text Display
Set Text Display.description: Sets the text component of target Text Display entity

attributes.name: text
attributes.description: The text to use. If not set, the mechanic will remove the text from the entity instead

examples:
ExampleTextDisplayEntity:
 Type: TEXT_DISPLAY
 DisplayOptions:
 Text: I am but a humble example, nothing to see here
 Skills:
 - settextdisplay{text="MUHAHAHA! YOU FELL FOR MY TRICKERY!";delay=100} @self ~onSpawn

attributes.name: ai
attributes.description: Sets the new mob AI. true enables it, false disables it

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The material for the block to be set to

attributes.name: physics
attributes.description: Whether to apply physics to the affected area

Setcollidable.name: Setcollidable
Setcollidable.description: Sets if the target of the mechanic should have a collidable hitbox or not. The result is equivalent to the Collidable Option.

attributes.name: collidable
attributes.description: Sets if the mob is collidable or not

Setgamemode.name: Setgamemode
Setgamemode.description: Sets the gamemode of the target player. Does nothing if the target is not a player. Requires the sync=true attribute.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The gamemode to change the target to.

Setgliding.name: Setgliding
Setgliding.description: Makes an elytra-equipped entity glide or stop gliding. This only works on players or entities that have elytra equipped in the chestplate slot. The targeted entity also has to be in the air at the time!

attributes.name: gliding
attributes.description: If the entity is forced to glide or not

Setglobalscore.name: Setglobalscore
Setglobalscore.description: Modifies the scoreboard-objective value of the fake player __GLOBAL__. This is a notarget skill and cannot affect any other players' score. Works exactly like the ModifyGlobalScore-mechanic, but is only capeable of performing the set-action.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Specifies the scoreboard objectiv to be changed. If the objective doesn't exist it will automatically be created by the mechanic

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to perform the operation with

Setgravity.name: Setgravity
Setgravity.description: Sets whether gravity affects the target entity.

attributes.name: gravity
attributes.description: Sets whether the entity uses gravity

Sethealth.name: Sethealth
Sethealth.description: Sets the health of the target entity.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Amount of health to set to

Setleashholder.name: Setleashholder
Setleashholder.description: Sets the leash holder of the caster to the targeted entity

attributes.name: remove
attributes.description: If the lead should be removed instead of set

Setlevel.name: Setlevel
Setlevel.description: Causes the casting mob to change its level.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: The type of the operation to perform

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: Amount used in the operation

Setmaterialcooldown.name: Setmaterialcooldown
Setmaterialcooldown.description: Sets a cooldown on items of a specified material on the target player

attributes.name: material
attributes.description: The material to set the cooldown to

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the cooldown in ticks

Setmaxhealth.name: Setmaxhealth
Setmaxhealth.description: Sets the max health of the target entity.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount to set max health by

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The method of setting max health. STATIC will set the max health directly to amount value. SCALE will set the new max health but also scale the current health of the entity accordingly

Setmobcolor.name: Setmobcolor
Setmobcolor.description: Changes the target color, can only be applied to colorable mobs such as shulkers or sheeps.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: The color name

Setmobscore.name: Setmobscore
Setmobscore.description: Modifies the a scoreboard-objective value of the casting mob. The skill is a no-target skill and will always affect the casting mob's score. Works exactly like the ModifyMobScore-mechanic, but is only capable of performing the set-action.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Specifies the scoreboard objectiv to be changed. If the objective doesn't exist it will automatically be created by the mechanic

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to perform the operation with

Setname.name: Setname
Setname.description: Sets the display name of the caster. This will not work with players.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name to set

examples:
MySkeleton:
 Type: Skeleton
 Display: 'Skeleton <caster.hp>/<caster.mhp><&heart>'
 Skills:
 - setname{name=<caster.name>;delay=2} @self ~onDamaged
 - setname{name=<caster.name>;delay=2} @self ~onTimer:10 ?incombat

Setnodamageticks.name: Setnodamageticks
Setnodamageticks.description: Sets the immunity ticks on the target. This should be delayed if used immediately during an attack since the ticks are applied after an event completes.

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: The NoDamageTicks to set (for how many ticks the mobs will be invulnerable under normal circumstances)

Setowner.name: Setowner
Setowner.description: Sets the "owner" attribute of the Mythic Mob to the given target. This is a special attribute used within MythicMobs, and different from the normal "vanilla" owner of a mob.
examples:
PetSheep:
 Mobtype: sheep
 Display: 'Pet'
 Health: 20
 Damage: 18
 Skills:
 - skill{s=SetOwner} @trigger ~onInteract
 - skill{s=HealOwner} @Owner ~onTimer:50

SetOwner:
 Skills:
 - setowner
 - message{m=You are now the owner of this mob!}

Setprojectilebulletmodel.name: Setprojectilebulletmodel
Setprojectilebulletmodel.description: Sets the CustomModelData on the current projectile's bullet. (DISPLAY bullet types only)

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The model to set the projectile to

Setraiderpatrolblock.name: Setraiderpatrolblock
Setraiderpatrolblock.description: Sets the target raider to patrol the given location

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: A Location Targeter, whose targeted location will be the specified one

Setraiderpatrolleader.name: Setraiderpatrolleader
Setraiderpatrolleader.description: Sets if the target raider should be a raider patrol leader or not

attributes.name: leader
attributes.description: Should the target raider be a leader

Setrotation.name: Setrotation
Setrotation.description: Changes the rotation of the target (only works on non-player entities).

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: If the change is relative to the target, boolean

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The new yaw

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The new pitch

Setscore.name: Setscore
Setscore.description: Modifies the scoreboard-objective value of a fake player name. Works like the Modify Score mechanic, but is only capable of performing the set-action.

Setskillcooldown.name: Setskillcooldown
Setskillcooldown.description: Sets the given metaskill's cooldown to the given value (in seconds)

attributes.name: skill
attributes.description: The metaskill of which you want to set the cooldown

attributes.name: seconds
attributes.description: The duration of the cooldown

examples:
ExampleSkill:
 Cooldown: 0
 OnCooldownSkill: ExampleSkill-DisplayCooldown
 Skills:
 - delay 0
 - setSkillCooldown{s=ExampleSkill;seconds=<skill.cooldown>/20} @self

Setspeed.name: Setspeed
Setspeed.description: Causes the target to change its speed attribute

attributes.name: speed
attributes.description: Speed multiplier to apply to the base speed of the entity

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of speed, can be FLY or any other string. If not exactly FLY, this will change walk speed

Setstance.name: Setstance
Setstance.description: Sets the "stance" attribute of the target Mythic Mob to the given string. Does nothing if the target is not a Mythic Mob.

attributes.name: stance
attributes.description: The string-name of the stance

examples:
AnotherSkill:
 Conditions:
 - stance bowphase
 Skills:
 - ...some bow skills

Settarget.name: Settarget
Settarget.description: Sets the mob's target to the target entity. If using threat tables, will increase threat to the threshold to change targets for the targeted entity.

Settargetscore.name: Settargetscore
Settargetscore.description: Modifies the a scoreboard-objective value of the specified targeter(s). Works exactly like the ModifyTargetScore-mechanic, but is only capeable of performing the set-action.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Specifies the scoreboard objectiv to be changed. If the objective doesn't exist it will automatically be created by the mechanic

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to perform the operation with

Settonguetarget.name: Settonguetarget
Settonguetarget.description: Sets the tongue target for a frog caster to the target entity.

Setvariable.name: Setvariable
Setvariable.description: Sets a variable. Variables can be permanent or temporary, and can be used in conjunction with conditions or placeholders to store data.

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: The name of the variable. Can optionally be prefixed with scope

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope of the variable, e.g. where the variable will be located

attributes.name: save
attributes.description: Whether the variable should save between reloads, reboots and disconnects. Does not apply to SKILL-scoped variables

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) the variable should last. Does not apply to SKILL-scoped variables

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value to set the variable to. Must be applicable for type or the mechanic will fail. Should be surrounded in double-quotes if using spaces or semicolons. Value can also include placeholders, even from PlaceholderAPI

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the variable. Set to STRING if you are using text instead of numbers

examples:
# Skill File
BearGrowl:
 TargetConditions:
 - variableEquals{var=target.heardbear;value="yes"} cancel
 Skills:
 - message{m="&7You hear a growling noise..."}
 - setvariable{var=target.heardbear;value="yes";type=STRING;duration=6000}

Setvariablelocation.name: Setvariablelocation
Setvariablelocation.description: Sets a value of type string. The value will depend on the location passed to the "value" parameter, and will include informations regarding coordinates and world of the target location

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The target location

Shield.name: Shield
Shield.description: Adds absorption hearts. Having maxShield as a greater value than amount is recommended.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the shield to give

attributes.name: maxabsorb
attributes.description: The maximum value the shield on the entity should be

Shieldbreak.name: Shieldbreak
Shieldbreak.description: Breaks the target player's shield block if they are blocking. Only works when targeting players.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration in ticks that the shield will be disabled for after the block is broken

Shieldpercent.name: Shieldpercent
Shieldpercent.description: Applies an absorb shield to the target entity for a percentage of their max health.

attributes.name: multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier. The value of the shield will be maxhealth*multiplier

attributes.name: maxabsorb
attributes.description: The max value of the shield must not be greater the max health of the mob multiplied by this value

Shoot.name: Shoot
Shoot.description: Shoots an arrow or item-projectile at the targeted entity or location that deals damage. The shoot-mechanic has been significantly changed in version 2.4. See below for both how it worked prior and after those additions.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Type of projectile to shoot.

attributes.name: damage
attributes.description: How much damage the projectile will cause

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the projectile

attributes.name: maxDistance
attributes.description: The maximum distance the projectile will travel

attributes.name: poweraffectsvelocity
attributes.description: Whether the mobs power level should affect the velocity of the projectile

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How often per second the projectile creates a tick-event

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The item being shot. Only applicable to some projectile types

attributes.name: ontickskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute on each tick/interval of the projectile

attributes.name: onhitskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute when the projectile hits its target

attributes.name: onendskill
attributes.description: The meta-skill to execute when the projectile misses and ends

attributes.name: bounce
attributes.description: Whether the projectile will bounce when it hits something

attributes.name: pickup
attributes.description: Can pickup the item.

attributes.name: expiration
attributes.description: How many ticks should the projectile exist for after it has landed before it gets removed

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy of the projectile

attributes.name: knockback
attributes.description: knockback strength of the projectile

attributes.name: piercelevel
attributes.description: The amount of times the arrow can pierce through an entity

attributes.name: verticaloffset
attributes.description: The vertical offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: horizontaloffset
attributes.description: The horizontal offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: forwardoffset
attributes.description: The forward offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: sideoffset
attributes.description: The side offset of the shot projectile

attributes.name: startsideoffset
attributes.description: The side offset of the shot projectile. Yes, it is the same as the above, but this attribute has placeholder support.

attributes.name: gravity
attributes.description: Whether the projectile should be affected by gravity

attributes.name: startyoffset
attributes.description: The starting y offset of the projectile

attributes.name: adjustvelocity
attributes.description: If the caster is a player, adjusts the velocity and direction as if the player was shooting it themselves

attributes.name: calculatefiringangle
attributes.description: If this is set and the projectile has gravity, the projectile will trace an arc in the air before landing at the target location

attributes.name: verticalnoise
attributes.description: The vertical noise (randomness) of the shot projectile

attributes.name: horizontalnoise
attributes.description: The horizontal noise (randomness) of the shot projectile

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether the projectile should be shot from the origin of the mechanic

attributes.name: potiontype
attributes.description: The type of the potion applied to the projectile, if POTION

attributes.name: potionduration
attributes.description: The duration of the potion effect

attributes.name: potionlevel
attributes.description: The level of the potion effect

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Whether to override the effect on the target if already applied

attributes.name: potioncolor
attributes.description: The color of the potion

attributes.name: hasParticles
attributes.description: Whether not to show the status effect particles.

attributes.name: hasIcon
attributes.description: Whether not to show the status effect icon.

attributes.name: ambientparticles
attributes.description: Whether to show ambient particles.

attributes.name: tridentitem
attributes.description: The trident item

Shootfireball.name: Shootfireball
Shootfireball.description: Shoots a fireball from the mob towards the target entity or location.

attributes.name: yield
attributes.description: The yield (power) of the fireball's explosion

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the fireball

attributes.name: fireTicks
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) fire left behind by the fireball will persist

attributes.name: incendiary
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the fireball will leave behind fire

attributes.name: charged
attributes.description: Whether the fireball is charged

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether the fireball should be shot from the origin

attributes.name: playsound
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the fireball launching sound when it is created

attributes.name: smallfireball
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the smaller blaze fireball instead of the ghast fireball

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the fireball

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The material of the fireball, if ITEM type was used

examples:
FireballBarrage:
 Skills:
 - shootfireball{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootfireball{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootfireball{y=1;v=4} @target

Shootpotion.name: Shootpotion
Shootpotion.description: Throws a potion at the targeted entity or location, causing the splash potion effect of the given type to all entities hit.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity of the thrown potion

Shootshulkerbullet.name: Shootshulkerbullet
Shootshulkerbullet.description: Shoots a shulker bullet at the target entity, giving them levitation on hit.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the bullet

attributes.name: damage
attributes.description: The damage of the bullet

attributes.name: bounce
attributes.description: Whether the bullet should bounce

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: how often in ticks this mechanic updates

attributes.name: onTick
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls each interval

attributes.name: onHit
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls when it hits the target

attributes.name: onEnd
attributes.description: the skill this mechanic calls when it ends

attributes.name: startyoffset
attributes.description: The starting y offset of the bullet

attributes.name: forwardoffset
attributes.description: The forward offset of the bullet

attributes.name: fromorigin
attributes.description: Whether to shoot the shulker bullet from the origin

examples:
TestingShootShulkerBullet:
 Skills:
 - ShootShulkerBullet{oT=TSSB_oT;oH=TSSB_oH;oE=TSSB_oE;i=1} @target
 
TSSB_oT:
 Skills:
 - particles{particle=reddust;color=#ffffff;size=0.66;a=2;hs=0;vs=0;s=0;y=0} @origin
TSSB_oH:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=5}
TSSB_oE:
 Skills:
 - particlesphere{particle=reddust;color=#ffffff;size=0.66;a=30;r=1;hs=0;vs=0;s=0;y=0} @origin

Shootskull.name: Shootskull
Shootskull.description: Shoots a wither skull from the mob towards the target entity or location.

attributes.name: yield
attributes.description: The yield (power) of the skull's explosion.

attributes.name: playsound
attributes.description: Whether or not to play the skull launching sound when it is created

examples:
SkullBarrage:
 Skills:
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target
 - delay 10
 - shootskull{y=1;v=4} @target

Show Dialog.name: Show Dialog
Show Dialog.description: Shows the target player a dialog from the dialogs folder: a window with text, items, inputs and buttons. Needs 1.21.6 or newer. On Folia, it opens on the player's region thread.

attributes.name: dialog
attributes.description: Dialog name. Case-sensitive. Supports placeholders

Showentity.name: Showentity
Showentity.description: Shows the caster, if hidden via the use of the hide mechanic, to the targeted players.

Signal.name: Signal
Signal.description: Sends a signal to the specified targeter. Won't do anything when targeted at players. The signal can be composed of any string. The mob(s) that receives the signal can only act upon it if it has a dedicated "~onSignal" trigger in its skill arsenal (see examples).

attributes.name: signal
attributes.description: The signal to send

examples:
# Mob file:
Master:
 Type: zombie
 Skills:
 - summon{m=Minion} @self ~onSpawn
 - signal{s=ATTACK} @MobsInRadius{r=10;t=Minion} ~onDamaged
Minion:
 Type: baby_zombie
 Skills:
 - skill{s=ShootAttacker} @NearestPlayer ~onSignal:ATTACK

Skill.name: Skill
Skill.description: Executes another MetaSkill, which must be located in /MythicMobs/Skills. The executed skill will inherit any targets if no targeter is specified.

attributes.name: skill
attributes.description: The metaskill to be executed

attributes.name: forcesync
attributes.description: Whether to force the skill to be run synchroniously with Minecraft

attributes.name: branch
attributes.description: Whether the called metaskill's skilltree should branch off from the skilltree of the calling mechanic. The branch will originally clone the skilltree, but any changes made to the branch will not reflect on the original skilltree

attributes.name: executeafterdeath
attributes.description: Whether the metaskill should be able to be called after the caster's death

attributes.name: snapshotcasterstats
attributes.description: Whether the caster's stats at the moment of the skill execution should be "saved in memory", so that every subsequent check/fetch operation made against them returns the saved amount. This can be useful if the metaskill includes somewhat big delays and the caster's stats can change during the metaskill execution

Skybox.name: Skybox
Skybox.description: Changes the skybox for the target players.

attributes.name: skybox
attributes.description: What skybox should be shown to the player

Slash.name: Slash
Slash.description: The Slash meta-mechanic can execute other skills in a slash-shaped pattern. The exact shape, size, location, rotation and other such elements of the slash itself can be tweaked via the attributes below.

attributes.name: onStartSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at the start of the slash

attributes.name: onEndSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at the end of the slash

attributes.name: onPointSkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed at every point of the slash

attributes.name: onHitEntitySkill
attributes.description: Meta-Skill executed when a point of the slash hits an entity. Only triggered once per entity for every execution of the slash mechanic

attributes.name: Points
attributes.description: The amount of points in the slash

attributes.name: specificStep
attributes.description: Define a specific step/index from the generated points which should be shown, when the supplied value is greaten than 0

attributes.name: Duration
attributes.description: The amount of ticks the slash should "travel" for. A value of 0 executes an instantaneous slash

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the slash. Increasing this value makes the slash's arc less arched

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height of the slash. Increasing this value makes the slash's arc more arched

attributes.name: Angle
attributes.description: The size of the arch in degrees

attributes.name: xOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the X axis

attributes.name: yOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the Y axis

attributes.name: zOffset
attributes.description: The offset on the Z axis

attributes.name: ForwardOffset
attributes.description: Forward offset

attributes.name: targetxoffset
attributes.description: Target X-axis offset

attributes.name: targetyoffset
attributes.description: Target Y-axis offset

attributes.name: targetzoffset
attributes.description: Target Z-axis offset

attributes.name: Pitch
attributes.description: The pitch rotation

attributes.name: Yaw
attributes.description: The yaw rotation

attributes.name: Roll
attributes.description: The roll rotation

attributes.name: Radius
attributes.description: The hit radius

attributes.name: Rotation
attributes.description: The rotation of the slash, in the x,y,z format. Same as using pitch/yaw/roll

attributes.name: MatchCasterDirection
attributes.description: Matches the direction of the slash to the caster's facing direction

attributes.name: directionTowardsTarget
attributes.description: If the yaw/pitch should be calculated to aim to the target

attributes.name: FromOrigin
attributes.description: If the slash should start in the origin of the metaskill

attributes.name: HitConditions
attributes.description: List of Inline Conditions that an entity must met to be hit by the slash mechanic

Smoke.name: Smoke
Smoke.description: Creates a puff of smoke at the location of the targeter.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: The direction the effect should play towards. Can be an integer from 1 to 4

examples:
SmokeMonster:
 Type: ZOMBIE
 Skills:
 - smoke @target ~onTimer:10
 - smoke{direction=2} @self ~onAttack

Smoke Swirl.name: Smoke Swirl
Smoke Swirl.description: Creates a swirling vortex of smoke at the targeted entity or location.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How many intervals the swirl will last

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How many ticks there are between each pulse of smoke

Sound.name: Sound
Sound.description: Plays a sound from either the vanilla game or a resource pack at the targeted entity or location. An extensive list of sounds can be found here. Using multiple sounds stacked together can give the impression of an entirely new sound.

attributes.name: sound
attributes.description: The sound to play

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch of the sound. Can be between 0.01 and 2.0

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: The volume of the sound.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius in which the sound will be heard

attributes.name: soundcategory
attributes.description: The category at which the sound is played, useful for resourcepacks

attributes.name: emitter
attributes.description: Anchor sound playback dynamically to an entity, rather than a static location

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The audience of the effect

Speak.name: Speak
Speak.description: Makes the caster speak using chat and speech bubbles. Supports Holograms. You can force a new line in the hologram by using \n

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: The y offset for the hologram.

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of entities which will see the chat message

attributes.name: maxlinelength
attributes.description: The maximum length of the hologram

attributes.name: lineprefix
attributes.description: The prefix for the hologram.

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: The message to be displayed (affects both hologram and chat)

attributes.name: chatprefix
attributes.description: The prefix for the chat message

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The amount of time the hologram will be displayed for.

attributes.name: sendchatmessage
attributes.description: Whether the message shows up in chat

attributes.name: audience
attributes.description: The Audience of the mechanic

Spin.name: Spin
Spin.description: Causes the target entity to spin around for the given duration. When a mob casts the spin mechanic repeatedly it will move upwards while spinning.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The velocity the target spins at

Spring.name: Spring
Spring.description: Creates a temporary "spring" of liquid at the target entity or location.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of spring. Can be water or lava

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration (in ticks) the spring will last

Steal Item.name: Steal Item
Steal Item.description: Steals an item from the target and puts it in the mob's hand

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount to steal

attributes.name: dropchance
attributes.description: Sets the chance for the stolen item to be dropped upon death

attributes.name: strict
attributes.description: Whether the matcher should more strictly match the target item

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: The items to match. Can be a list

attributes.name: vanillaonly
attributes.description: Whether the matched item can only be a vanilla one

attributes.name: onStealSkill
attributes.description: The Metaskill to execute once an item is successfully stolen

Stop Sound.name: Stop Sound
Stop Sound.description: Stops a sound from playing from either the vanilla game or a resource pack for the targeted entity. A good list of sounds can be found here. Use the “sound event” column.

attributes.name: sound
attributes.description: Sound to stop playing

attributes.name: soundcategory
attributes.description: The category at which the sound is played, useful for resourcepacks

Stopusingitem.name: Stopusingitem
Stopusingitem.description: Stops the targeted living entity from using an item, i.e. blocking with a shield.
examples:
Skills:
 # basic example
 - stopusingitem @NearestPlayer
 
 # with an aura to prevent the player from using a shield
 - aura{onTick=[ - stopusingitem ?isBlocking ];duration=500} @NearestPlayer

Sudoskill.name: Sudoskill
Sudoskill.description: The SudoSkill mechanic allows you to force the targeted entity to “cast” a MythicMobs Metaskill, even if the targeted entity is a player. No single mechanics can be used straight: they have to be in a Metaskill!

attributes.name: setcasterastrigger
attributes.description: Sets the trigger of the called metaskill to the caster of this mechanic

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Sets the inherited targets of the called metaskill to the specified ones

attributes.name: chained
attributes.description: Whether to make each target of the mechanic cast the specified metaskill sequentially, each time targeting the previous caster

Suicide.name: Suicide
Suicide.description: Instantly kills the mob. This is a no-target mechanic and will only affect the casting mob. This won't work on a few non-mob entities like boats or armor stands! For them, the use of Remove is advised!

Summon.name: Summon
Summon.description: Summons mobs of the given type around the target.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of mob to summon. Can be a Mythic Mob type or a regular entity type

attributes.name: onSummon
attributes.description: The metaskill to execute on the summoned mobs

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The number of mobs to summon.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The level of the mob being summoned

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw of the summoned entities. If not set, will inherit the caster's

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch of the summoned entities. If not set, will inherit the caster's

attributes.name: usetargetyaw
attributes.description: Whether the yaw of the target location/entity should be used to set the yaw of the summoned entity, unless the yaw attribute is set

attributes.name: usetargetpitch
attributes.description: Whether the pitch of the target location/entity should be used to set the pitch of the summoned entity, unless the pitch attribute is set

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius around the target within which the mobs will be summoned

attributes.name: yRadius
attributes.description: Overrides the Y component of radius.

attributes.name: yRadiusUpOnly
attributes.description: Whether the Y spread should only go upward, not downward.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The maximum initial velocity the mob will have once summoned, making the mob be propelled in a random direction

attributes.name: yvelocity
attributes.description: Same as velocity, but only applied to the y axis

attributes.name: onSurface
attributes.description: (true/false) Whether the mobs should be spawned only on a solid block

attributes.name: copyThreatTable
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should copy the parent's threat table. Requires threat tables to be enabled on the summoned mob to function.

attributes.name: inheritThreatTable
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should share a threat table with the parent. Requires threat tables to be enabled on the summoned mob to function.

attributes.name: inheritFaction
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mobs should have the same faction as the parent

attributes.name: inheritdespawn
attributes.description: Whether the summoned mob should inherit the caster's Despawn Option

attributes.name: summonerIsOwner
attributes.description: Whether to set the summoner as the owner of the mob.

attributes.name: summonerIsParent
attributes.description: Whether to set the summoner as the parent of the mob.

Summon Falling Block.name: Summon Falling Block
Summon Falling Block.description: Summons a falling block of the specified material at the targeted locations

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The material of the falling block

Summonareaeffectcloud.name: Summonareaeffectcloud
Summonareaeffectcloud.description: Creates a cloud of particles around the target location

attributes.name: particle
attributes.description: The particle effects to use

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of the effect given by the cloud

attributes.name: potionduration
attributes.description: The duration of the potion effect

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The level of the potion effect

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration of the particle cloud

attributes.name: durationreudctiononuse
attributes.description: The duration reduction for the cloud on use

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the cloud

attributes.name: radiusreductiononuse
attributes.description: The radius reduction for the cloud on use

attributes.name: radiusreductionontick
attributes.description: The radius reduction for the cloud per tick

Summonpassenger.name: Summonpassenger
Summonpassenger.description: Summons a mob to mount the caster. Will knock the current rider off if there is one.

attributes.name: passenger
attributes.description: The type of the mob to set as the passenger

attributes.name: stack
attributes.description: Sets whether to mount the summoned entity to the current passenger of the caster

Swap.name: Swap
Swap.description: Swaps the caster and targets locations

Swing Offhand.name: Swing Offhand
Swing Offhand.description: Makes the casting player swing their offhand

Switch.name: Switch
Switch.description: A switch allows a condition to be tested against a list of (cases) values.

attributes.name: uniqueresult
attributes.description: Whether to stop execution of other skills if a condition was met

attributes.name: condition
attributes.description: A condition to test for

attributes.name: cases
attributes.description: A list of cases to evaluate

examples:
MyCoolMob:
 Type: ZOMBIE
 Skills:
 - switch{condition=entitytype{t=<case>};cases=
 case SKELETON=[
 - message{m="A SKELETON JUST HIT ME"} @Server
 ]
 case HUSK=[
 - message{m="A HUSK JUST HIT ME!"} @Server
 ]
 case PIG=[
 - message{m="NOOO A PIG"} @Server
 ]
 case DEFAULT=[
 - message{m="SOMEONE or SOMETHING HIT ME OUT OF NOWHEREE!!"} @Server
 ]
 } @trigger ~onDamaged

Take Experience Levels.name: Take Experience Levels
Take Experience Levels.description: Takes experience levels from the targeted players

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of levels to take

Takeitem.name: Takeitem
Takeitem.description: Removes the specified amount of an item from the target player's inventory. Uses the Item Matcher

attributes.name: item
attributes.description: The item, or material, to remove

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount to remove

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: Whether the name of the item should match exactly to the specified one

attributes.name: vanillaonly
attributes.description: Whether the matched item can only be a vanilla one

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: The Item variable whose value is to be taken from the inventory. When set, item is ignored

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description: Modifies the threat level that the caster holds with the target entities

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: How the threat should be assigned

Teleport.name: Teleport
Teleport.description: Teleports the caster to the targeted location/entity. The end point of the teleportation will be within an area whose size depends on the spreadh and spreadv attributes.

attributes.name: spreadh
attributes.description: The horizontal spread of the landing location.

attributes.name: spreadv
attributes.description: The vertical spread of the landing location.

attributes.name: preservepitch
attributes.description: Whether the pitch value should be carried over

attributes.name: preserveyaw
attributes.description: Whether the yaw value should be carried over

attributes.name: unsafe
attributes.description: Avoids finding a safe teleport (will ignore sH and sV)

Teleportin.name: Teleportin
Teleportin.description: Will teleport the target relative to the caster's yaw. The direction attribute must be in this format: direction=x,y,z

attributes.name: vector
attributes.description: The direction to where the mob will be teleported

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: Yaw modifier

attributes.name: targetasorigin
attributes.description: Will use the target's location as the origin instead of the caster's

Teleportto.name: Teleportto
Teleportto.description: Will teleport the targeted entity or entities to the specified location.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The coordinates of the teleport's destination, or a targeter

attributes.name: world
attributes.description: The destination-world. Optional attribute if "location" is given

attributes.name: yaw
attributes.description: The yaw that the affected entities should assume

attributes.name: pitch
attributes.description: The pitch that the affected entities should assume

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: Whether the location is relative or directional

attributes.name: targetasorigin
attributes.description: Will use the target's location as the origin instead of the caster

Teleporty.name: Teleporty
Teleporty.description: Teleports the caster to the specified Y coordinate. No target is required for this mechanic, as the caster will always be the one that is teleported.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Where to teleport on the Y axis

Terminable.name: Terminable
Terminable.description: Creates an aura that, each tick, checks if a set of conditions is met: If so, the execution of the onStart skill is immediately cancelled.

attributes.name: terminateconditions
attributes.description: The conditions to check against

attributes.name: deep
attributes.description: Whether the terminable aura, once its conditions have been met, should also stop the execution of the metaskill it has been called from

attributes.name: onterminate
attributes.description: The metaskill to execute once the onStart is terminated

examples:
ExampleSkill:
 Skills:
 - terminable{deep=true;...}
 - skill:test1
 - delay 100
 - mechanic2

SecondarySkill:
 Skills:
 - mechanic1
 - delay 200
 - mechanic3

Threat.name: Threat
Threat.description: Modifies the mob's threat value towards the target. Requires the casting mob have Threat Tables enabled in order to have any effect.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of threat to give the target. Can be negative.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode of the operation

Throw.name: Throw
Throw.description: Throws all targets away from the mob (or origin).

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The horizontal velocity at which the entity is throw

attributes.name: velocityY
attributes.description: The vertical velocity at which the entity is thrown

attributes.name: fromOrigin
attributes.description: Sets whether to throw the entity from the origin

examples:
SuperShockslam:
 Skills:
 - throw{velocity=5;velocityY=5} @PIR{r=10}
 - damage{a=50;i=false} @PIR{r=10}
 - effect:particles{p=hugeexplode;a=5;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=1} @Self
 - effect:sound{s=entity.generic.explode;v=2;p=0.5} @Self
 - effect:sound{s=entity.generic.explode;v=2;p=1;repeat=7;repeatInterval=2} @Self
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=1} @Self
 - delay 2
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=3} @Self
 - delay 2
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=5} @Self
 - delay 2 
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=7} @Self
 - delay 2
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=9} @Self
 - delay 2
 - effect:particlering{p=largeexplode;a=40;vs=0.5;hs=0.5;s=0;y=0.3;points=20;radius=11} @Self

Thunder Level.name: Thunder Level
Thunder Level.description: Causes a per-player storm effect (without rain)

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The type of the effect. Either 0 or 1

Time.name: Time
Time.description: Sets the world's time. Depending on the attributes used, the change in time can be absolute or relative to the target player.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The mode used in the time mechanic. Can be ADD/SET/RESET

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of ticks by which the time will be changed

attributes.name: personal
attributes.description: Sets whether to change the global time or the player's client time

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: Sets whether to keep the player's time synchronized to its world time with an offset

examples:
# Mob File
ExampleMob:
 Type: ZOMBIE
 Skills:
 - sudoskill{s=MidnightAura} @PIR{r=30} ~onTimer:20

Toggle Piston.name: Toggle Piston
Toggle Piston.description: Toggles a piston at the target location

Togglelever.name: Togglelever
Togglelever.description: Toggles a lever on and off at the supplied coordinates.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Location of the action, in a x,y,z syntax. If set, other location attributes are ignored

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: The duration (in ticks) the lever should remain toggled on.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: The X coordinate of the button.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: The Y coordinate of the button.

attributes.name: z
attributes.description: The Z coordinate of the button.

Togglesitting.name: Togglesitting
Togglesitting.description: Toggles the sitting state for cats, dogs, foxes, and parrots.

attributes.name: setSitting
attributes.description: Sets the sitting state

Totem.name: Totem
Totem.description: The totem mechanic places an invisible "totem", similar to the projectile mechanic, except that it doesn't move. Much like projectiles, you can use onTick skills to create effects in order to identify the totem's location.

attributes.name: Charges
attributes.description: Determines how many times the totem can hit something before disappearing

attributes.name: YOffset
attributes.description: How high off the target the totem will spawn

attributes.name: stopatentity
attributes.description: Whether the totem should terminate upon hitting an entity

attributes.name: hugsurface
attributes.description: Whether or not the totem should be aligned with the ground

attributes.name: hugliquid
attributes.description: Whether, when using hugSurface, a liquid can also count as a "surface" the totem can align itself with

attributes.name: heightfromsurface
attributes.description: How high above the surface the totem should align itself if HugSurface is set to true

attributes.name: faceawayfromcaster
attributes.description: Whether the totem should face away from the caster when first placed

examples:
MyFirstTotem:
 Skills:
 - totem{ch=1;i=1;md=8;onTick=MFT_TICK} @self

MFT_TICK:
 Skills:
 - damage{a=3} @ENO{r=5}

Totem Of Undying.name: Totem Of Undying
Totem Of Undying.description: Plays the effect of a totem resurrecting a player with options to specify CustomModelData to use from resource packs.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: The CustomModelData to use for the shown totem

Tracklocation.name: Tracklocation
Tracklocation.description: Sets the casting mob's tracked location to the targeted location. Please note that a player cannot have a tracked location. This location can then be used via the relevant Targeter and Condition.

Undisguise.name: Undisguise
Undisguise.description: Removes the mob's active disguise, if it has one. This skill requires Libs' Disguises to be installed to enable Disguise functionality.

Undopaste.name: Undopaste
Undopaste.description: Undoes a previous paste done via the fawePaste mechanic, based on its id or on the schematic used

attributes.name: pasteID
attributes.description: The id of the paste that needs to be undone

examples:
ExampleMob:
 Skills:

 # With ID
 - fawePaste{s=cgym.schem;id=abc} @self ~onSpawn
 - undoPaste{id=abc} @self ~onDamaged

 # Without ID
 - fawePaste{s=lab.schem} @self ~onSpawn
 - undoPaste{id=lab.schem} @self ~onDamaged

Variable Move.name: Variable Move
Variable Move.description: Moves an already created variable across names and/or registries. By default, no new variable is created, so this can be used to make two different registries reference the exact same variable, allowing the modifications on one to reflect on the other

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: The variable to move, in the scope.name format

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: Where the variable should end up, in the scope.name format

attributes.name: removeOld
attributes.description: Whether the moved variable should be removed from the old variable registry

attributes.name: createNew
attributes.description: Whether a new variable should be created at the target variable registry

attributes.name: inheritExpirationTime
attributes.description: If createNew is true, whether the new variable should inherit the expiration time from the old one

Variableadd.name: Variableadd
Variableadd.description: Adds an amount to a variable on the specified scope.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The value to add

Variablemath.name: Variablemath
Variablemath.description: Sets a variable to the result of a math equation, where 'x' is the variable's current value.

attributes.name: equation
attributes.description: The operation to be done, must be inside quotes

Variableskill.name: Variableskill
Variableskill.description: Executes another meta-skill like the Skill mechanic, but allows for placeholders inside the skill attribute. The attribute "sync=true" will be inherited by any sub-skills and cannot be set to false later in a skill-tree.

attributes.name: skill
attributes.description: The metaskill to be executed. Accepts Placeholders

attributes.name: forcesync
attributes.description: Whether to force the skill to be run synchroniously with Minecraft

attributes.name: branch
attributes.description: Whether the called metaskill's skilltree should branch off from the skilltree of the calling mechanic

attributes.name: executeafterdeath
attributes.description: Whether the metaskill should be able to be called after the caster's death

attributes.name: variable
attributes.description: The MetaSkill variable whose value is to be executed. When set, skill is ignored

examples:
ExampleSkill:
 Skills:
 - vskill{s=ExampleSkill_<random.1to3>} @self

ExampleSkill_1:
 Skills:
 - effect:particles{particle=reddust;color=#FF0000;amount=10}
ExampleSkill_2:
 Skills:
 - effect:particles{particle=reddust;color=#FFFFFF;amount=10}
ExampleSkill_3:
 Skills:
 - effect:particles{particle=reddust;color=#00FF00;amount=10}

Variablesubtract.name: Variablesubtract
Variablesubtract.description: Subtracts an amount to a variable on the specified scope.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The value to subtract

Velocity.name: Velocity
Velocity.description: Modifies the velocity of the targeted entity(s). May be used on players, too. Useful for all sorts of things like true knockback resistance, force-skills or simulated wind.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: The operation to perform. Can be SET, ADD, REMOVE, DIVIDE, or MULTIPLY.

attributes.name: velocityx
attributes.description: Velocity on the x-axis. Can be negative.

attributes.name: velocityy
attributes.description: Velocity on the y-axis. Can be negative.

attributes.name: velocityz
attributes.description: Velocity on the z-axis. Can be negative.

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: If the change in velocity should be relative to the target's facing direction. In this instance, the z axis becomes forward/backward, y becomes up/down and x becomes left/right

Volley.name: Volley
Volley.description: Shoots a volley of arrows or item-projectiles at the targeted entity or location that deals damage. Can use any attribute from the Shoot mechanic.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of projectiles

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The type of the volley. Can be REGULAR or RAIN

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius of the volley spread. Only applies when source=RAIN.

attributes.name: yoffset
attributes.description: The vertical offset of the rain source above the target. Only applies when source=RAIN.

attributes.name: spread
attributes.description: How spread out the volley is (random yaw/pitch jitter, in degrees)

attributes.name: canPickup
attributes.description: Whether the arrows can be picked up by players

Wait.name: Wait
Wait.description: Puts the metaskill on hold (like the delay mechanic) until a set of conditions is met.

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: Conditions to check against. When the conditions are met, the metaskill will continue

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: How often, in ticks, the mechanic should check against its condition

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: The maximum amount of ticks to wait before the metaskill is put out of hold even if conditions aren't met

attributes.name: cancelSkill
attributes.description: Whether, once a timeout happens, the metaskill should cancel execution instead of resuming

attributes.name: cancelConditions
attributes.description: A set of conditions that, if met, will make the mechanic resolve and the metaskill resume immediatly, like if the primary set of conditions was met

Weather.name: Weather
Weather.description: Changes the weather in the casting mob's world.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of weather. Can be "sunny", "rainy", or "stormy"

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: How long (in ticks) the weather will be forced to last

Wolfsit.name: Wolfsit
Wolfsit.description: Sets the sitting state of the target wolf.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: The state the wolf is in. True = sitting and False = standing

World Edit Replace.name: World Edit Replace
World Edit Replace.description: Replaces blocks in a region using WorldEdit. Needs a @region or similar targeter

attributes.name: from
attributes.description: The material to replace

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: The material to set in place of the replaced one

Altitude.name: Altitude
Altitude.description: This condition tests how far above the ground the target entity is.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: The height range to check

attributes.name: maxHeight
attributes.description: Limits the maximum height this condition can checks for

Biome.name: Biome
Biome.description: This condition tests if the target is within the given list of biomes. If no namespace is provided, it will default to minecraft:

attributes.name: biome
attributes.description: A list of biomes to check

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: Whether to match the biome exactly

Biometype.name: Biometype
Biometype.description: Tests if the target is within the given list of biome types

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: A list of biomes to check

attributes.name: exact
attributes.description: Whether to match the type exactly

Block Type In Radius.name: Block Type In Radius
Block Type In Radius.description: Checks against the amount of specified blocks in a radius around the evaluated location.

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: A list of materials to check against

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: The radius

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of blocks to match

Blocking.name: Blocking
Blocking.description: This condition tests if the target player is blocking with a shield.

Blocktype.name: Blocktype
Blocktype.description: This condition tests if material type present at the target location is the specified one. Valid for any Spigot material type, wildcards and block tags.

attributes.name: types
attributes.description: A list of materials or MMOItem's block name to check. Does also support wildcards and block tags

Bounding Boxes Overlap.name: Bounding Boxes Overlap
Bounding Boxes Overlap.description: Checks if the caster's BoundingBox overlaps with the target's

attributes.name: shiftforward
attributes.description: The forward offset of the caster's BoundingBox

Bowtension.name: Bowtension
Bowtension.description: Checks the bow tension of when an entity shoots from a bow

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: The value of the force/tension to check for. Accepts ranged float values, but only in a range from 0 to 1

Burning.name: Burning
Burning.description: Checks if the target entity is burning

Chance.name: Chance
Chance.description: Sets the probability of the metaskill being executed.

attributes.name: chance
attributes.description: The floating value which denotes the chance. It can range between 0 and 1, with 0 being a 0% chance and 1 being a 100% chance

Charged.name: Charged
Charged.description: Checks if the target creeper is charged

Children.name: Children
Children.description: Checks how many children the caster has.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of children to check for. Can accept ranged values.

Color.name: Color
Color.description: Checks the color of Sheeps, Shulkers, Cat (Type), Parrots (Variants), Horses, Llamas, and TraderLlamas.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: the color to check for

Compare Values.name: Compare Values
Compare Values.description: Compares two values based on a specified operation. The comparison is made from value1 against value2: This means that, for instance, in the > operation, it will return true if value1 is greater than value2.

attributes.name: value1
attributes.description: The first value of the comparison

attributes.name: value2
attributes.description: The second value of the comparison

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: The operator to use

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The (optional) type of the comparison. If not set, will try every available type from more stringent to less stringent. If set, the comparison will only happen assuming the values are of the specified type. Accepts any Variable Type

fields.name: Conditions
fields.description: Conditions in this section check against the caster or its location. Checks if the caster has more than 10 health points In the example above, the globalscore condition will check the caster's global score.

fields.name: TargetConditions
fields.description: Conditions in this section check against the inherited target of the metaskill Checks if the inherited targeted entities have more than 10 health points, and only those that do will be inherited as an inherited target by the metaskill. If none do then the metaskill, by default, will not execute. The example above the globalscore condition will check the inherited target's global score. Since globalscore is an entity condition, it will only work if an entity is targeted.

fields.name: TriggerConditions
fields.description: Conditions in this section check against the trigger of the metaskill Checks if the trigger of the metaskill has more than 10 health points

Crouching.name: Crouching
Crouching.description: This condition checks if the target player is crouching or not.

Cuboid.name: Cuboid
Cuboid.description: Whether the target is within a cuboid that has location1 and location2 as opposite vertices

attributes.name: location1
attributes.description: x,y,z coordinates for the 1st point.

attributes.name: location2
attributes.description: x,y,z coordinates for the 2nd point.

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: Whether or not the coordinates should be relative to the caster

Damage Amount.name: Damage Amount
Damage Amount.description: Checks for a range of damage the entity took, if the skilltree originated from a onDamaged Trigger or an onDamaged Aura.

attributes.name: damageAmount
attributes.description: Range of damage to check for

Damage Cause.name: Damage Cause
Damage Cause.description: Checks the cause of the damage the entity took, if the skilltree originated from a onDamaged Trigger or an onDamaged Aura. A list of valid damage causes can be found in the Spigot DamageCause javadoc.

attributes.name: damagecause
attributes.description: The damage cause to match

Damagetag.name: Damagetag
Damagetag.description: Checks whether the damage that caused the current skill tree has a specific tag

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: The tag to check against

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: If true, checks for the presence of the tagIf false, checks for its absence

Dawn.name: Dawn
Dawn.description: Checks if the time in the world at the target location is dawn, from 22000 to 2000 in-game time.

Day.name: Day
Day.description: Checks if the time in the world at the target location is day, from 2000 to 10000 in-game time.

Dimension.name: Dimension
Dimension.description: Checks if the target is within a certain dimension. A list of valid dimensions can be found in the Spigot Enviroment javadoc.

attributes.name: dimension
attributes.description: A list of dimensions to check

Directionalvelocity.name: Directionalvelocity
Directionalvelocity.description: A condition that checks checks if the target has a velocity matching the given parameters.

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: The X velocity. Can be a range. Isn't checked by the condition if not set

attributes.name: absx
attributes.description: Whether to use only the absolute values for the X velocity

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: The Y velocity. Can be a range. Isn't checked by the condition if not set

attributes.name: absy
attributes.description: Whether to use only the absolute values for the Y velocity

attributes.name: z
attributes.description: The Z velocity. Can be a range. Isn't checked by the condition if not set

attributes.name: absz
attributes.description: Whether to use only the absolute values for the Z velocity

attributes.name: relative
attributes.description: Whether the check should be relative to the entity's orientation and not to the world axis. If true, X is forward/backward and Z is side-to-side

Distance.name: Distance
Distance.description: Whether the distance between the caster and target is within the given range. Can be a single number, a ranged value (20to40), or >10 <5, etc.

attributes.name: distance
attributes.description: The distance to match

Distance From Location.name: Distance From Location
Distance From Location.description: Whether the distance between the target and a specified location is within a certain range

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: The x component of the location

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: The y component of the location

attributes.name: z
attributes.description: The z component of the location

attributes.name: world
attributes.description: The world of the location. Defaults to the world of the target

attributes.name: distance

Sphere.name: Sphere

attributes.name: radius

attributes.name: points

attributes.name: yoffset

attributes.name: exact

Target Block.name: Target Block

attributes.name: ignoreTransparent

Target Location.name: Target Location
Target Location.description: Targets the location the casting player is looking at, or the locations of the mob's target

attributes.name: maxdistance
attributes.description: The maximum distance to check for the location, if the caster is a player

attributes.name: ignoreTransparent
attributes.description: If transparent blocks should be ignored

Target Predicted Location.name: Target Predicted Location
Target Predicted Location.description: Targets the predicted location at which the caster's top target will be after an amount of ticks has elapsed, based on its current movement speed.

attributes.name: maxdistance
attributes.description: The maximum distance from the target's current location that the predicted location can be located at. If the predicted location is supposed to be further away, this targeter will instead "fall short" of it, targeting the location maxdistance blocks away form the original target's location, alongside its movement vector

attributes.name: ticksPredicted
attributes.description: How "far into the future" this targeter should predict.

attributes.name: ignoreTransparent
attributes.description: Whether the raytrace used for the prediction should ignore transparent blocks

Targeted Location.name: Targeted Location
Targeted Location.description: Targets the inherited targeted locations. Useful for Targets Filtering by using Targeter Options.

Targeted Target.name: Targeted Target
Targeted Target.description: Targets the inherited targeted entities. Useful for Targets Filtering by using Targeter Options.

Targeters.name: Targeters
Targeters.description: Targeters are used to determine what a skill targets when it is fired.

attributes.name: targetconditions
attributes.description: Inline Target Conditions

attributes.name: fallback
attributes.description: The fallback targeter to use, if this one returns no target

attributes.name: sudoparent
attributes.description: If this attribute is set to true, the targeter will be parsed as if it was the Parent of the casting entity executing the mechanic

attributes.name: sudoowner
attributes.description: If this attribute is set to true, the targeter will be parsed as if it was the Owner of the casting entity executing the mechanic

attributes.name: sudotrigger
attributes.description: If this attribute is set to true, the targeter will be parsed as if it was the Trigger of the skilltree executing the mechanic

attributes.name: useboundingbox
attributes.description: If the targeter is performing a distance check, this option allows it to check against the bounding box of the target instead of the center of its hitbox

attributes.name: unique
attributes.description: The maximum number of times an entity can be targeted. Defaults to 1, disable with 0. This is mostly used for meg models with multiple hitboxes

attributes.name: nomegbb
attributes.description: Whether MEG sub hitboxes should be filtered out

attributes.name: xoffset
attributes.description: Centers the offset on the x axis

attributes.name: yoffset
attributes.description: Centers the offset on the y axis

attributes.name: zoffset
attributes.description: Centers the offset on the z axis

attributes.name: forwardOffset
attributes.description: Centers forward and backward offset, based on the caster's viewing angle

attributes.name: sideOffset
attributes.description: Centers left and right offset, based on the caster's viewing angle

attributes.name: upoffset
attributes.description: Centers up and down offset, based on the caster's viewing angle

attributes.name: rotatex
attributes.description: Rotation on the x axis

attributes.name: rotatey
attributes.description: Rotation on the y axis

attributes.name: rotatez
attributes.description: Rotation on the z axis

attributes.name: coordinatex
attributes.description: Sets the x axis coordinate

attributes.name: coordinatey
attributes.description: Sets the y axis coordinate

attributes.name: coordinatez
attributes.description: Sets the z axis coordinate

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Multiplied the direction vector by the specified value

attributes.name: blocktypes
attributes.description: Only targets selected block types. Multiple blocks can be listed by separating them using a ,You can add a # at the front of the type to indicate that the block only needs to match part of the type, add @ to indicate that the block only needs to match the start of the typeYou can add a * at the front of the type to indicate that the one specified is not a block type, but a block tag (example: blocktype=*sculk_replaceable )

attributes.name: blockignores
attributes.description: Excludes selected block types from the targeter. Multiple blocks can be listed by separating them using a ,Can use the special syntaxes specified in blocktype

attributes.name: coordinateyaw
attributes.description: Sets the yaw value

attributes.name: coordinatepitch
attributes.description: Sets the pitch value

attributes.name: blockcentered
attributes.description: Boolean value. If set to true, the center of the block at the target location will be targeted, instead of the target location itself

attributes.name: faulty
attributes.description: Whether the old vector calculation formula should be used

attributes.name: blockSurface
attributes.description: Whether the plugin should attempt to adjust the location to be on a surface

attributes.name: blockSurfaceTolerance
attributes.description: The tolerance used when searching for a surface, when blockSurface is set to true

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: The entity types to target

attributes.name: ignore
attributes.description: The entity types to not target

attributes.name: targetself
attributes.description: Whether to target the caster of the mechanic

attributes.name: targetplayers

attributes.name: targetcreative

attributes.name: targetspectator

attributes.name: targetinvulnerable
attributes.description: Whether to target invulnerable entities

attributes.name: targetarmorstands

attributes.name: targetmarkers
attributes.description: Whether to target markers

attributes.name: targettextdisplays
attributes.description: Whether to target text displays

attributes.name: targetitemdisplays

attributes.name: targetblockdisplays
attributes.description: Whether to target block displays

attributes.name: targetinteractions

attributes.name: targetnpcs

attributes.name: targetanimals

attributes.name: targetcreatures

attributes.name: targetsamefaction

On Death.name: On Death
On Death.description: Executes the skill when the mob dies. If the server is a Paper one, it is possible to cancel the death event as long as the cancelevent mechanic is synched. The health that the mob has after this is based on what is specified in the ReviveHealth Option.
examples:
EXAMPLE_MOB:
 Type: CHICKEN
 Skills:
 # sends a message to all the players in the world
 # when the mob dies
 - message{m=DEATH} @World ~onDeath

ImmortalCow:
 Type: COW
 Display: '&eImmortal Cow'
 Health: 20
 Options:
 ReviveHealth: -1
 Skills:
 - skill{s=[
 - cancelevent
 - particle{p=HEART;hs=0.5;vs=0.5;y=1.5}
 - speak{m=Call an ambulance, but not for me!}
 ];sync=true} @self ~onDeath

On Dismounted.name: On Dismounted

 Type: HORSE

 - skill{s=[
 - cancelevent
 - message{m=Going somewhere?} @trigger
 ];sync=true} @self ~onDismounted 0.7

On Enter Bounds.name: On Enter Bounds
On Enter Bounds.description: This Trigger has a special syntax: ~onEnterBounds{corner1=<location>;corner2=<location>} for a cuboid, or ~onEnterBounds{shape=<sphere|cylinder>;location=<location>;radius=<number>} for a sphere or cylinder

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: cuboid, sphere, or cylinder

attributes.name: corner1
attributes.description: First corner of a cuboid: a location targeter, pin name, world,x,y,z, or x,y,z

attributes.name: corner2
attributes.description: Second corner of a cuboid, in the same formats as corner1

attributes.name: x1, y1, z1
attributes.description: Replaces that coordinate of corner1 after it is resolved

attributes.name: x2, y2, z2
attributes.description: Replaces that coordinate of corner2 after it is resolved

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Center of a sphere, or the center of a cylinder's base: a location targeter, pin name, world,x,y,z, or x,y,z

attributes.name: radius
attributes.description: Radius of a sphere or cylinder

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of a cylinder, measured up from location

Guides/%28Extra%29-Text-Editors.content_md:
When working with MythicMobs, knowing how everything works is only half the battle: the other half is writing it down, and if you are not using a proper text editor, it might prove challenging to manage all of the files and configurations you will need to make. Fortunately, there are a lot of cool options out there! While in this guide we will be focusing only on Visual Studio Code as it is the editor on which the MythicScribe Extension can be used, any text editor will work fine!

## VSCode Extension

## Creating a Workspace

One of the most handy features of VSCode is the ability to create a "Workspace", essentially something that will allow you to persistently keep all open files and use custom settings for your project. To make a Workspace, you can start by right clicking the folder you want to start on: for Mythicmobs, this folder can be either the root folder or that of a Pack, depending on what you are using and what you want to do

- You can select a folder by right clicking it and selecting "Open with Code"

- After you have opened that, you can navigate to File > Save Workspace As... and select a valid path for the new workspace file to be created

- To open the workspace again, you can double click on the generated workspace file

And that's all! You just created a workspace, that will allow you to more easily keep track of changes and edit things!

## Customizing The Workspace

After a workspace has been created, workspace-specific settings can be made, so that only the selected workspace will have them, as to not "mess up" other working areas.

To access them, after having opened the workspace, you can navigate to File > Preferences > Settings > Workspace and set them up!

## Workspace Utilities

##### Editing Files

- You can both create, edit and rename files and folder directly in Vscode's Explorer: just right click the relevant folder/file and select what you want to do

##### Pinning Tabs

- You can pin important tabs by right clinking then and selecting Pin. This will not only keep them open, but using any "close all" option will not close pinned tabs and they will be fixed at the start of the tab list

##### Split View

- In case you need to work both on a skill and mob file at the same time, you can split one of them, so you can see both of them at the same time. For this, simply click on the relevant open tab and select "Split X", where X is the desired location (Up, Down, Left, Right)

##### Bulk Changes

- If you want to rename a metaskill or a mob, you can:

- Use the search and replace function you can find on the right (the magnifying glass icon) to change that across all workspace files

- Use the Change All Occurrences button (Select the word you want to change and use right click) to change every occurrence of that word inside of its file

The Wiki is a big and scary place, but it is home to all the information you can need. Here are a few tips that can make navigating the wiki much easier!

# Searching

Using the search bar located at the top of the page can sometimes be less than reliable, but it is an option. A more ideal approach is identifying which section you need and pressing ctrl+f on your keyboard to search through that page. For example, heading to the Mechanics page presents you with a long list of every mechanic. Using ctrl+f you can simply search "Message" and it will take you to the Message mechanic. The same process can be applied to each category, Mechanics, Triggers, Targeters and so on.

Guides/%28Step-1%29-Understanding-the-di.content_md:
MythicMobs contains a lot of different features and terms which are important to learn. This page gives a brief description of all the different things you may encounter while working on your mobs.

## Mobs

Mobs Wiki

As the name of the plugin suggests, mobs are the most important, core component of MythicMobs.

### Options

Mob Options Wiki

Mob Options allow you to change various settings about your mob. Not all mobs can use all the options so check the wiki page to see what can be used for what mob types.

### Custom AI

Custom AI Wiki

Custom AI lets you change how your mob behaves by default. You can make them choose different targets, and act a different way towards them. Custom AI is made up of 2 selectors, Goals and Targets.

Goals: Determine what your mob does, such as running from players, floating in water and attacking.

Targets: Determine who or what your mob targets, such as Players and other mobs.

## Mechanics

Mechanics Wiki

Mechanics are the main way to add interesting and unique abilities to the mobs you create. The most basic way to use a mechanic is to add it to your mobs Skills section along with a trigger and targeter, but you can also add them in MetaSkills. Most mechanics have a list of attributes which can be used with them to modify how they work.

- giveitem{i=DIAMOND;cd=10} @NearestPlayer ~onTimer:20

## Targeters

Targeters Wiki

Targeters are what tell your mechanics who to target. For example if you are using the giveitem mechanic, the targeter will decide who to give the item to.

- giveitem{i=DIAMOND;cd=10} @NearestPlayer ~onTimer:20

## Triggers

Triggers Wiki

Triggers tell your mobs when to activate their mechanics and abilities. Triggers must start with a ~ and be placed after the Targeter. Triggers can only be put directly on your mobs, they will not work if written in a MetaSkill. In the example, ~onTimer:20 is the trigger, telling the mechanic to run every 20 ticks (1 second)

- giveitem{i=DIAMOND;cd=10} @NearestPlayer ~onTimer:20

## Conditions

Conditions Wiki

Conditions allow you to limit how things are executed. You can do inline conditions or use the conditions section wherever you are using them.

## Attributes

Attributes are the information you can pass to a mechanic/targeter/condition to customize how it works. In this example cd=10 and i=DIAMOND are the attribute, telling the mechanic the item to give and to have a cooldown of 10 seconds. Attributes are seperated by a ; symbol and must have a = before what you set.

- giveitem{i=DIAMOND;cd=10} @NearestPlayer ~onTimer:20

| Attribute | Aliases | Description | Default |

|---|---|---|---|

| attribute1 | alias1, alias2 | The description of what the attributes does | default value |

| attribute2 | alias3 | The description of what the attributes does | default value |

| attribute3 |  | The description of what the attributes does | default value |

Is telling you that the mechanic has 3 different attributes: attribute1, attribute2 and attribute2. Each attribute has an associate description of what it does and a "default value" that will be applied to it if none is explicitly specified. Some attributes also have "aliases", that are just different names you can use to set the same attribute.

> This mechanic inherits every inheritable attribute of the Damage mechanic

And it means that, in addition to the attributes on the wiki page itself, the ones in the indicated mechanic are also used unless "non-inheritable". For instance, the Damage mechanic used for an example has a single attribute that cannot be inherited (amount), while all others are used

## MetaSkills

MetaSkills Wiki

Skills are a fundamental feature of MythicMobs, they allow you to combine multiple mechanics into one giving you the ability to create interesting attacks and functions with multiple effects and visuals.

## Items

Items Wiki

MythicMobs has the ability to create basic custom items which can be used by mobs or given to players. You can expand upon these items if you have the MythicCrucible addon plugin.

## RandomSpawns

RandomSpawns Wiki

RandomSpawns are used to make your mobs naturally spawn in your worlds, without the need for commands or spawners. You can add conditions to decide when they spawn.

## Spawners

Spawners Wiki

Spawners can be used to spawn mobs periodically at a set location. These can be useful for dungeons or RPG maps.

Please note: Spawner files CANNOT be edited while the server is running, you must stop your server to edit the files. You can use in-game commands instead.

## Variables

Variables Wiki

Variables are a handy system used for storing information. You can then use the information in various other places such as placeholders in mechanics and conditions.

## Placeholders

Placeholders Wiki

Placeholders are used to display/fetch information from an entity, a location or a MetaSkill. For instance, the <caster.hp> placeholder can be used to fetch the amount of hp for the casting entity
